"Deal with it. She's not replacing you. This is her house now."

Even my son took her side.

"Stop being dramatic! Natalie actually loves us! You're nothing!"

But their pure, innocent Natalie? She unplugged my mother's ventilator while I was locked in the basement. Let his enemies slip poison into my drink during the last job.

When Grayson found me, all he said was: "She's pregnant and emotional. Go rearrange the flowers at the wedding venue."

I wipe the black blood from my lips. Look at him quietly.

"I'm dying."

title: They Loved Me After I Left
description:
I'm Jennifer, a stay-at-home mom. I gave up my art career eight years ago to take care of my family. My husband Julian and my son Garry, they're my whole world.
But lately, I've noticed them getting closer to Mia, Julian's secretary. Little things. Garry asking where "Miss Mia" is. Julian mentioning her at dinner. I told myself it was nothing. I kept quiet. I put up with it.
Until last week, when Garry broke his arm playing hockey. The school called Mia, not me. She was listed as his emergency contact.
That's when I knew I was done.

title: Crawling Into His Captain's Bed
description:
Three years of chasing Chase Blackwood, and all I got was a front-row seat to him tonguing my "sister."
The old me would've cried. Begged. Made a scene.
The old me also ended up dead.
Funny how a second chance at life gives you clarity.
So here's what's different this time: I'm done being the pathetic ex. I'm done playing nice.
I'm throwing champagne in his face and climbing into bed with Asher Hayes—his best friend, his rival, his worst nightmare.
And Chase? He can rot.

title: I slept with my son's hockey captain
description:
After faking orgasms with her husband for years, 45-year-old Judy is thrown out of the house the moment he discovers the truth.
By accident, Judy ends up having a one-night stand with Romeo — her son's hockey team captain and closest friend.
Romeo corners Judy against the wall and demands a forbidden relationship with her. She keeps telling him no… but every touch makes it harder and harder for her body to obey her heart.

title: Double Lover
description: Alyssa Sterling, a young female officer, is assigned to an undercover operation and forced to part with her beloved fiancé, Travis Blake. Five years later, while investigating an international drug trafficking ring, she discovers that her new undercover target is Travis himself—now a leading heir apparent to the Crimson Lotus gang. Thrown onto opposite sides yet still bound by unresolved feelings, the two reunite in the criminal underworld. As they engage in a fierce battle of wits and deception, they gradually rediscover the love they once shared. But Alyssa has a duty to uphold as a police officer, and she is soon driven into a painful choice between love and justice.

title: Professor's Secret Classroom: The Price of Redemption
description: Megan was the broken girl in the front row, hiding bruises under her white shirt. Logan was the cold, distant professor who saw through her lies. When Logan saves Megan from a brutal assault in the locker room, their professional boundaries shatter. He offers her a gilded cage in his luxury estate, promising protection from her abusive stepfather, Benjamin. But as their secret lessons turn into a dark, forbidden obsession, Megan realizes that Logan’s love might be just as dangerous as the monsters she’s running from. In a world of scandals, hidden cameras, and betrayal, how far will a professor go to own the soul of his student?

title: The Mafia Don Crumbled After I Vanished
description:
Seven years of marriage turned to ash the moment I discovered my husband had arranged for his sister-in-law to carry his dead brother's child—using his own sperm to continue the family bloodline.
Lorenzo Corvino—New York's most ruthless don—would drive three hours through a storm just to get me imported cherries. He held me at my mother's funeral, crying until dawn. He hospitalized a man for disrespecting me at a charity gala.
I thought I was the center of his world.
Until the private investigator's flash drive revealed the truth: Lorenzo at the clinic for Claudia's prenatal appointments, his hand on her pregnant belly, whispering "Marco would be so proud."
In the end, on the Corvino family's scale of priorities, continuing his dead brother's bloodline would always outweigh his infertile wife.
The night the yacht exploded, the New York sky burned red. The news reported the mafia don's wife had perished in the flames. He collapsed on the dock, clutching the charred wreckage, breaking down completely.
But he didn't know—
That "dead" woman was across the Atlantic on the Amalfi Coast, one hand on her seven-week baby bump, protecting the secret he'd never discover.
Seven months later, when he stepped into my new life and saw the infant with his deep brown eyes cradled in my arms—
This man who'd built an empire on violence and fear finally understood what he'd truly lost.
And I'll spend the rest of my life making sure he knows: some betrayals are so deep, even "I'm sorry" is more than he'll ever deserve.

title: I Stopped Waiting after the Ninth Divorce
description:
I divorced the same man nine times.
The first eight times, I was the one sobbing, begging him not to go.
The ninth time, I was the one who slid the papers across the table.
He signed them, then told me we'd remarry once she left.
I said okay.
What he didn't know was that my flight was already booked.
This time, I was leaving for good.

title: The Bodyguard I Abused Became My Husband
description:
As the only daughter of a mafia family, I learned early that trust doesn't come cheap. When my father got sick, he gave me an ultimatum: if I want to take over the family, I have to get married first.
Everyone assumed I'd pick my childhood friend, Vincent Moretti—son of my father's right-hand man. Hell, even I thought so. Until my last life, when he left me to burn.
Father died in an ambush. I was trapped in a metal cage at an abandoned dock warehouse while flames swallowed everything. I begged Vincent for help. He stood thirty feet away, the cage key right by his feet.
"Cat, as long as your father's alive, he'll never give me the family. This isn't personal. It's business."
Sophia was wrapped around him—my so-called best friend. She smiled at me and said she'd take good care of everything.
Before I lost consciousness, I saw a figure in black charging into the flames—Elijah, the bodyguard I'd called "trash" and "a dog."
Then I opened my eyes and woke up a month before my birthday party. This time, I'm giving that position to someone who actually deserves it.
But why is Vincent on his knees at my engagement party, crying and begging me to marry him?

title: Professor, Your Brother Dumped Me
description:
The night Julian Wright orchestrated his "rose ceremony," everyone expected a full meltdown.
They were taking bets—would I show up sobbing, or would I skip straight to the roof? After all, everyone knew I was broke. Without Julian's money, I'd be out on my ass.
But when Julian handed that rose to campus queen Chloe Miller, the ballroom doors never opened. No crying. No scene. The whole party lost its main event.
What nobody knew was that while Julian was busy playing bachelor, I was sitting on his half-brother's leather couch in nothing but an oversized white dress shirt. Bare legs tucked under me.
I glanced up at Vincent, catching my lower lip between my teeth. "Your couch is soaked. Where exactly are you planning to sleep tonight?"
Vincent Wright's throat worked. Hard. He dragged his gaze away like it physically hurt. When he spoke, his voice came out wrecked: "Stay put. I'll grab a towel."
A beat. Then rougher: "Need to get you dry."

title: After Being Stood Up Nineteen Times, I Walked Away
description:
Nineteen times. That's how many times Lucas promised to marry me, only to leave me standing alone because of her.
Today was supposed to be our day. But as I stood in the biting cold outside the restaurant, watching him carefully help Selena into his Maybach, the marriage application still tucked in my purse, I finally understood—that "someday" would never come.
"Let's reschedule the registration, okay?" he'd said without even looking at me.
I walked straight to HR and submitted my resignation. Then I accepted the offer from the Morinetti family—his sworn enemies.
As I boarded my flight to the West Coast, my phone exploded with messages.
"We agreed to go to City Hall today. Where are you?"
I glanced at the screen one last time, then powered it off.
"We're done."

title: Crashing into His Vengeance
description:
I am the jubilant champion's girlfriend, the blissful woman who will reveal to him tonight, "We are to become parents." Yet, I overheard the brutal truth: "The very thought of her mother once climbing into my father's bed fills me with revulsion for every second of this five-year charade." 
It turns out that five years of affection was nothing more than a meticulously orchestrated deceit. 
In that moment of heartbreak and excruciating pain, our child slipped away as if making the final decision on my behalf. I incinerated all our memories, rendering them vapor in this world. 
When that once indomitable champion finally realized his misplaced animosity, and in a desperate bid to find me, fractured his spine amidst the ruins while signing a pact with fate...I am the jubilant champion's girlfriend, the blissful woman who will reveal to him tonight, "We are to become parents." Yet, I overheard the brutal truth: "The very thought of her mother once climbing into my father's bed fills me with revulsion for every second of this five-year charade." 
It turns out that five years of affection was nothing more than a meticulously orchestrated deceit. 
In that moment of heartbreak and excruciating pain, our child slipped away as if making the final decision on my behalf. 
When that once indomitable champion finally realized his misplaced animosity, and in a desperate bid to find me, fractured his spine amidst the ruins while signing a pact with fate...

title: Divorced Ten Times for Her
description:
Everyone knows Adrian loves me more than life itself. When that car crashed, he threw himself over me and took the hit. First thing he said when he woke up in the hospital: "Where is she? Is she okay?"
Everyone says I married the best man in the city.
What they don't know is this man has married me ten times. And divorced me ten times. All for the woman he's never gotten over.
The first time, I got on my knees and begged him not to leave. He just looked at me with those cold eyes and said, "Don't embarrass yourself."
The fourth time, we were fighting in the car. Then we crashed, and I lost our baby.
By the seventh time, I stopped crying. Just signed the papers, packed my things, waited for him to come back like he always did.
My tears, my compromises, all those times I bent until I nearly broke. What did I get? Him coming back like clockwork, just to do it all over again.
This time, when he slides that tenth divorce agreement across the desk, I finally get it. Some people's hearts never had room for you in the first place.
So this time, I'm throwing him out. Him and this whole Mrs. Hayes charade. Straight into the trash where they belong.

title: My Boyfriend's Last Kiss
description:
At a late-night party, when the bottle spins to my boyfriend Tyler, he picks dare.
"Kiss anyone here except your girlfriend," the host announces with a smirk.
Tyler barely hesitates. He walks straight to my best friend Sienna and kisses her for a full seven seconds in front of everyone.
When he comes back, he leans close to my ear. "Don't sweat it, we'll have fun when we get home."
When it's my turn, I choose truth. "Tell us a secret nobody knows."
I look around at all these drunk college kids, then say calmly, "I killed someone."

title: Every Time She Prayed, My Baby Died
description:
Three years of marriage. Three pregnancies.
Every time I confirmed I was pregnant, my sister-in-law Ophelia would walk into the chapel behind the manor.
Then my in-laws would drag me to the hospital and force me to abort the healthy baby.
The night after my third miscarriage, I dragged my weakened body to follow her into the chapel.
The moment I pushed open that door, my blood ran cold.
In that instant, I finally understood why my three children had to die.

title: The Wife's Deadly Temptation
description: Renee Lane was betrayed by her husband, who got involved with her best friend and even plotted to kill her to seize the Lane Group. She later returns under the new name Remy Lang to take revenge.

title: Mocked by My Wife
description: To help make his wife's dream of becoming an influencer come true, Bryan Zeller, the president of internet giant Keystone Group, disguises himself as a lowly security guard and stays by Sophie Scott's side while she builds her career. On their wedding anniversary, he plans to surprise her with a billion-dollar contract as a gift. But instead, his sweet influencer wife Sophie turns around and climbs into James Cole's luxury car—then ends up trending across the platform with him. When Bryan goes to confront them, Sophie and James shower him with mockery and insults, all because they think he's nothing more than a security guard.

title: Love Me, Hate Me
description: Whitney is framed for the death of Julian's sister. Torn between love and hatred, Julian keeps Whitney imprisoned by his side. What Whitney doesn't know is that he's doing it to protect her. Desperate to escape, she fights with everything she has to get away—only to learn the truth when it's already too late, and by then, nothing can be undone.

title: Dead Man's Revenge
description:
"Felix Lynch, gravely ill, unexpectedly discovers that his wife, Victoria, is not only having an affair, but is also plotting with her lover to seize his entire inheritance and even sell their daughter.
 With only one month left to live, Felix has no choice but to use the little time he has left to set a trap—one that will make both of them, especially Victoria, who holds inheritance rights and legal custody of their daughter, disappear for good.
 Weakened by his illness, Felix turns to Snow, a woman who shares a common enemy with him, and brings her in as his partner to help carry out this deadly plan."

title: Dark moonlight
description: Cindy Wren killed someone by accident fifteen years ago while saving Yann Pike. After getting out of prison, she discovers that her younger sister, Snow Wren, who had been working at Harlan Shaw's house, has suddenly vanished. To find out what happened, Cindy infiltrates the Shaw household as a maid and uncovers the murders committed by Harlan and his wife Vivian. While avenging her sister, she crosses paths with Yann again. She initially plans to use him to bring down Harlan, but as they work together, they fall for each other and ultimately join forces to bring the guilty to justice, rekindling their relationship after everything is finally over.

title: My Ex’s Stepfather Became My Addiction
description: My name is Elena Ross, and I’m a sex addict. This is the secret I guard with medication. But right now, the blizzard has sealed the road and cut off my escape. In this narrow car, the man sitting beside me is the one forbidden fruit I absolutely cannot touch—Silas Thorne. He’s not just my boss; he’s my ex-boyfriend’s stepfather.

title: I Married the Man Who Planned My Rape
description:
I thought my husband was my salvation.
Until I overheard him in the wine cellar, laughing and joking with my "attackers" from that night.
The gang rape that destroyed me was a show he orchestrated himself.

He married me only for inheritance rights.
He humiliated me, branded me, took away my child, and made my life a living hell.
But he forgot one thing—
The ancient blood oath of the Corleone family states clearly:
If a husband betrays his marriage, everything he owns shall belong to his wife.

This time, I'm no longer the rabbit waiting to be slaughtered.
This time, I write the ending.

title: Remarried for Revenge
description:
"Valerie Summer, a top fashion designer, discovers that her fiancé, Miles Luke, is cheating on her with her best friend, Callie Lane. Worse, Callie steals her designs and enters them in a competition under her own name. Determined to get revenge, Valerie enters into a contract marriage with Evan Guthrie, the CEO of the Guthrie Group.
 After their whirlwind marriage, the two work seamlessly together, driving Miles's Skyline Group into a steep decline. In the end, Evan acquires it for a fraction of its value. Along the way, Valerie and Evan's relationship quietly shifts from a marriage of convenience into a real and lasting love."

title: His Unknown Wife
description:
"Gifted with extraordinary talent, Zoe Allen originally wanted to build a name for herself at home. But her ex-boyfriend, empowered by his family's influence, refused to leave her alone. With no other choice, Zoe was forced to leave the country, even if it meant walking away from her new husband, Theo Kane.
Relying on her talent and relentless hard work, she rose to become one of the world's top designers. Always private and cautious, she hid her identity behind the alias Luna.
All the while, to make up for leaving Theo behind, Zoe quietly supported the growth and success of his company from the shadows. With her exceptional ability and striking beauty, she attracted no shortage of admirers. Among them, Julian Frost, heir to the global luxury powerhouse DK Group, pursued her with relentless devotion and stayed by her side overseas. But Zoe remained unmoved, her heart still set on her husband.
After achieving fame and success, Zoe returned home full of hope, ready to finally live a happy life with Theo. Instead, she discovered that Theo had been cheating on her with Vivian, a fellow designer. Worse still, Vivian had been using Luna's name to deceive others and build her own reputation.
What hurt Zoe most was that the husband she had never stopped caring about had no idea that it was his own wife who had been supporting him in secret all along.
After getting rich, Theo became arrogant. He proposed a divorce, lashed out at Zoe with cruel words, and treated her with contempt. Proud and strong-willed, Zoe walked away without hesitation. Even after losing Zoe's support, Theo continued to show off, claiming that he had secured design authorization from Luna. But at the critical moment, Zoe exposed him. Backed into a corner, Vivian finally admitted that she was not Luna at all. Theo was left stunned, and the entire Kane Group collapsed in scandal and financial ruin. Vivian was arrested and sent to prison.
In the end, Zoe revealed that she was the real Luna. And under Theo's devastated, regret-filled gaze, she accepted...

title: Happy New Year
description:
"Near the New Year's, the Hale family finally tracked down their long-lost twin children. Out of gratitude, Farron Hale and his wife Nina accepted Nora as their mother and brought her to the city to celebrate the holiday with them.
 After arriving in the city, Farron and Nina treated Nora with the utmost respect, but Nora could not stop thinking about her biological grandson. Taking advantage of the trip, she went to see him herself. But under the influence of his mother, Skye, the boy was just as cold and unkind.
 After a series of events—including the family dinner and reunion banquet—her son realized his mistakes and divorced Skye, and the whole family finally reconciled and reunited in happiness."

title: Cryo-Woken 97yo Scientist: Owns Her Toxic Grandson
description:
67 years ago, genius scientist Serphina was critically injured while saving her son, Fred, and was forced into cryogenic treatment. When she unexpectedly awakens 67 years later, she discovers that the SL tech empire she built has been seized by her unworthy descendants—and the beloved son she once protected has become a frail old man, imprisoned in an iron cage and brutally abused by his own son and grandson.
Everyone mistakes her for a lowly caregiver in a uniform. They mock her as powerless, humiliate her, and even attempt to sell off the core patents that represent her life’s work. But none of them know that the young woman standing before them is the legendary “Queen of Science” herself—Seraphina.
When she takes back full control, and the president of the Global Academy of Sciences kneels before her, calling her “Teacher,” every villain finally begins to tremble. Her toxic grandson, vicious daughter-in-law, and every traitor who betrayed her—none will escape.
After 67 years of frozen silence, Seraphina has returned for one reason: to protect her son, reclaim her empire, and personally bring every betrayer to justice.

title: Five Years of IVF While He Already Had Twins
description:
I almost died on the operating table trying to give Alexander Volkov a child, unaware he already had a pair of illegitimate twins with his childhood sweetheart.
My heart stopped when I saw the DNA results. Alec, the man who made the New York underworld tremble, the man who flew back on a private jet just to hold my hand, was a flawless liar.
I turned my face away, tears soaking the hospital pillow. My hand drifted to my belly. God had finally decided to give me a break after five years of needles and agony—I was pregnant. But now, it felt like the cruelest joke.
He pulled me into his arms, smelling of expensive cologne and... baby formula.
"Tell me what's wrong, honey. Whoever made you unhappy, I'll make them pay."
I stared into his lying eyes and made my decision. 
I would vanish with his unborn child, leaving him to rot in eternal regret.

title: A Hot Trip with My Ex's Stepdad
description: I have a secret that could end my career: I’m a sex addict, and I just ran out of medication. Now, I’m stranded in a forest with the last man on earth I should be near—Sebastian Blackwood, my CEO and my ex-boyfriend’s powerful stepfather. Three years ago, he was untouchable; now, we’re sharing a tiny tent. As the cravings take over, Sebastian realizes I’m not just "sick"—I’m burning for him. When he discovers I’m still a virgin despite my condition, his control snaps. He’s not just my boss anymore; he’s the only one who can save me from myself.

title: Carrying His Baby into the Grave
description: Alexander Thornton shut down Fifth Avenue just to watch fireworks with me, kneeling before the world to call me his reason to live. I believed his perfect lies for seven years—until a video revealed his secret home and the son I could never give him. While I lay in a hospital bed, he was smelling of baby powder and building a global empire for his mistress. He thinks he can keep his "perfect wife" and his secret family, but I’m done playing my part. I’m carrying his miracle baby into the grave, leaving him with nothing but a positive pregnancy test and a ghost to haunt his billions.

title: He Cheated on Me 99 Times
description: Judy has caught her fiancé Henry cheating ninety-nine times, and every single time, she forgave him—because a rare condition causes her to lose her memory every morning. Henry treats her like a queen by day, but uses her illness as a "cheat code" to bring his mistresses into their home by night. When a car accident suddenly cures Judy’s amnesia, she discovers the horrifying truth: Henry didn't just cause her illness; he’s been praying she never gets well. Pregnant and fueled by rage, Judy decides to play the fool, documenting every betrayal as she prepares to destroy the man who thought he could play God with her mind.

title: The CEO’s Stolen Identity
description: Melanie Walton, the secret wife of billionaire Lucas Walton, goes undercover as an intern to save his company. But when the butler’s daughter steals her identity and seduces her husband, Melanie is treated like trash in her own empire. Subjected to brutal bullying and stripped of her dignity, she must watch as an imposter lives her life. Now, the real Queen must stop hiding and destroy everyone who tried to steal her throne.

title: Her Vengeful Grace
description:
"June Young, a powerful businesswoman and the third wife of the chairman of Global Finance, lost her young daughter during an internal power struggle within the company after the girl was abandoned by her father.
 After her husband's death, June took over as the CEO of Global Finance and became the target of an assassination attempt. During the attack, she was rescued by a mercenary named Sirocco, who was hiding from his own enemies. She later kept him by her side as her personal bodyguard."

title: Bringing Home a Rented Boyfriend
description:
"Yvette Lewis was the only daughter in her family, and everyone in the extended clan looked down on her. They thought it was disgraceful that at twenty-five she still wasn't married, had no money, and insisted on working out of town.
 Then Yvette hit the lottery.
 With a casual wave of her hand, she decided to rent a boyfriend to bring home for the New Year. That's when she met Jason Boone.
 Jason mistook Yvette for a blind date his mother had arranged. Just like that, he climbed into her car and got hauled straight back to her hometown.
 Yvette assumed Jason came from a dirt-poor family and his parents had forced him into this line of work—boyfriend rental. The moment they arrived, her aunts and distant relatives swarmed them with questions. Yvette fired back with cool comebacks to each one.
 Her cousin Megan showed up with her own boyfriend, and everyone immediately started comparing him to Jason, saying Yvette and Jason were broke losers who couldn't make it in life.
 Jason spoke up boldly, claiming the gifts he'd brought were just as good, if not better.
 That night, Yvette slapped down a million bucks in front of Jason. ""Buy whatever you want. Just say you bought it yourself."" She promised she'd have his back.
 Jason was genuinely touched. He stepped outside to call his assistant and have him prepare some serious gifts.
 When he came back, the two accidentally kissed. Jason's heart fluttered a little, but Yvette just said, ""Do I need to pay extra for that?""
 The next day at the family estate, Yvette got ambushed again by the elders lecturing her. Megan made a grand entrance with her boyfriend, bragging that she'd brought five hundred thousand dollars' worth of gifts, mocking Yvette and Jason.
 Jason grabbed Yvette's hand and told her to snap her fingers.
 Yvette snapped with style.
 A swarm of bodyguards and assistants flooded into the courtyard, each one carrying different luxury gifts, shutting everyone up. Over time, through various small incidents, Jason found himself drawn to Yvette's quirky char...

title: Mommy, I Brought Back Our Billionaire Dad
description: 8-year-old sweetheart Amara sells her mother's promise necklace to save her critically ill mom, Mia, and accidentally finds her biological father, billionaire Leo. The villainous Victoria falsely claims credit for saving Mia and repeatedly schemes against her. In the end, the truth comes to light — Mia is the one who donated her bone marrow to save Leo years ago. The family of three is happily reunited.

title: Play Fire With The Mafia Boss
description:
Impoverished college student Freya is forced to seduce the cold-blooded mafia boss Valentino in order to save her mother. Within thirty days, she must lure him into sleeping with her. If the untouchable don breaks his vow, his brother Marco will be able to seize the inheritance without resistance.
Step by step, Freya tempts him, risking her life as she tests the limits on the edge of danger. Yet the ruthless godfather, who has always kept his distance from women, begins to fall for her little by little. As desire and danger intertwine, can the two of them ignite a spark of love amid a deadly game of temptation?

title: The Billionaire's Too Late Repentance
description: After her husband Bradley stood by while his mistress crushed her sculpting hand and forced her to sign a divorce on her knees, Charlotte vanished into the storm. Two years later, she returns as a world-renowned artist, only for a devastated Bradley to finally learn the truth: Charlotte was the one who saved his life all along. He’ll tear the city apart and crawl through glass to win her back, but Charlotte has a new life—and a new man. Is his blood-soaked repentance enough, or is it simply far too late?

title: Mess Wrong With The Officer’s Sister
description:
Carol, the pregnant sister of war hero officer Christopher Jones, gets into a car accident on her way to a prenatal checkup when she collides with wealthy heiress Amanda Walker. Amanda refuses to let her go and demands compensation, even calling in her sister Blair to back her up.
However, upon arriving at the scene, Blair mistakenly assumes that Carol is her fiancé Christopher's mistress, sparking a lot of baseless accusations and relentless harassment against her.
In the end, Christopher steps in—determined to make the Walker family realize they've provoked the wrong person.

title: Surrender to the Silver Fox: The Master's Contract
description: Celia’s world shatters when her father sells her virginity to the ruthless Amul mafia family. Just as she faces a living nightmare, Pierre—a powerful, silver-haired tycoon and her father’s oldest friend—intervenes and claims her as his own. But his rescue comes with a price: a secret contract demanding her total obedience to his every whim. As Pierre pushes her to the edge of desire with calculated discipline, Celia finds herself falling for the very devil who controls her breath. When she is forced into a black wedding dress by his enemies, Pierre shatters the altar with a private army, proving that no one takes what belongs to the Silver Fox.

title: Bound to the Mafia King
description: After escaping the foster care system, Nova moves to New York to build a life of her own. By a twist of fate, she ends up in a flash marriage with a man named Dante, who appears to be nothing more than an ordinary logistics driver. Determined to protect their hard-earned home, Nova works tirelessly and cherishes their quiet life together.

title: Ex’s Police Daddy Wants Me
description: Rookie cop Lindsay discovers her boyfriend has been cheating on her with her stepsister. In a drunken haze, she nearly crosses a dangerous line with her boyfriend's father, Dominic—only to find out he is her newly assigned superior at the station. Irresistibly drawn to him, Lindsay falls deeper into temptation, while Dominic struggles against their forbidden attraction… even as he tries to mold her into his own submissive.

title: No Love in Vain
description:
"Every night, Vance is haunted by dreams of a pair of bloody hands reaching for him. Everything changes when he meets Natalie. After an unexpected kiss, Vance realizes Natalie may be the key to breaking the curse that has been tormenting him. At the same time, Natalie begins seeing him in her own dreams. She first approaches him because of work, but as their lives become more deeply entangled, real feelings begin to grow between them.
As the curse worsens, Vance's health begins to fail. Then Natalie uncovers a terrifying truth: she may be the very source of the curse. Determined to save him, she sets out to find a way to break it, only to discover that everything is tied to a tragic bond from a past life. Caught between misunderstanding and revelation, the two struggle against fate, unable to let each other go.
Across a hundred years of reincarnation, love and hatred remain intertwined, drawing them back together once more. Through tears, Natalie faces him and says, ""Vance, I never forgot you. I've always been able to see you.""
After a love story stretched across a century, obsession, and destiny, can they finally find their happy ending?"

title: Trapped in a Gilded Marriage
description: To pay for her dying brother's medical bills, Joanna willingly became a caged bird for billionaire Charles Thorne. For three years, she endured public humiliation, his mistress’s taunts, and even swallowed the "vitamins" he handed her—pills designed to steal her right to motherhood. Then she uncovered the ultimate betrayal: Charles hid a compatible heart donor report to seal a business deal, letting her brother die while he watched fireworks with his mistress in London. Joanna’s soul died that night. Shedding every symbol of her gilded cage, she left behind divorce papers, one word—Murderer—and vanished. Three years later, at the Golden Hall in Vienna, Joanna takes her bow as a celebrated cellist. Meanwhile, the man who once owned her kneels in the freezing snow, begging for a single glance from a woman who has already declared him dead.

title: He Drowned His Pregnant Wife for Another Woman
description: She once saved his life, married him with all her heart, and carried his child. But for his beloved mistress, he locked his pregnant wife in a rusted iron cage and drowned her in the icy lake. She died with their unborn baby, then returned as a ghost to watch him fall apart. He thought it was just a punishment, until he dragged her blood-soaked corpse from the lake—only to discover the cruel truth behind everything. Who really set her up?

title: Little Mother, Big Heart
description: Laura Lane suffers from dwarfism and endures constant disdain and ridicule, losing hope in life. Just as she contemplates ending it all, she encounters the baby Lunaria, reigniting her will to live. Laura decides to raise Lunaria into adulthood. However, the village bully, Luke Strong, covets Lunaria's beauty and resorts to threats, bribery, and even violence. The mother and daughter fight back fiercely, enduring humiliation, and Laura is left severely injured as a result.

title: Mother's Confession
description: Twenty years ago, Susan eloped with Kieran Smith, abandoning her husband and daughter. Now, twenty years later, she returns home due to kidney failure, pleading with her daughter Gianna Sharpe to donate a kidney. Gianna, feeling abandoned, refuses and faces moral pressure from her mother along with threats from her brother Dylan Smith. Dylan attempts to bully Gianna and insult her father, David Sharpe, unaware that Gianna is the CEO of the Celestial Corp.

title: Unforgotten Love
description: What is love? It's Miles and Tessa, separated for five years, yet somehow finding their way back to each other. It's every word spoken in denial, every excuse that carves a fresh wound on your own heart before the other party. It's that simple confession: "Tessa, all I want is you." The world is vast, but all I ask for is just one person to love.

title: Revenge in Disguise
description: Evelyn Lynn is a prodigy painter. Driven by jealousy of Evelyn's talent, the wealthy heiress Shannon Sue accidentally killed Evelyn's identical twin sister, Yvonne Lynn. To avenge her sister, Evelyn assumed the alias Evie, underwent surgery to look exactly like her enemy Shannon, and planned to infiltrate the Sue family for revenge. By a twist of fate, she discovered the secret of Sean Frost, CEO of the Frost Group: He's allergic to women...

title: （Dubbed）My Ex-Wife, My Doctor
description: After two years of marriage to Daniel Foster, Chloe Kelly had endured constant provocations from the "old mistress." Once she saw through her husband's cold indifference, she didn't hesitate—she slapped the divorce papers on the table and walked away. Daniel scoffed at first, thinking she was just being dramatic and would come crawling back soon enough. He had no idea Chloe would return to her medical roots and quickly rise to fame as a renowned men's health specialist. As for the mistress Daniel always thought of as his "savior," Jess Wever turned out to be an academic fraud in every sense—her credentials were fake, and she'd been lying to Daniel for years. By the time Daniel came groveling back, Chloe was already making waves in the men's clinic. She picked up her acupuncture needles with a smirk. "Need a treatment too, ex?"

title: Then Us, Now Gone
description:
"Janet Sheen gave up her life as the Sheen family heiress just to marry Timothy Lowe, a poor nobody at the time. She poured everything she had into helping him rise to the top and build Greenfield Group from scratch. For five years, their marriage seemed perfect—Timothy was loving, devoted, and Janet truly believed he would keep his promise to love her and only her for a lifetime.
 But just as Janet was convinced their happiness would last, Timothy's nanny, Nancy, suddenly returned from overseas. She insisted on moving in as Timothy's ""personal housekeeper"" The relationship between them was anything but normal, and Nancy's intentions were clearly suspect.
 Despite Janet’s repeated warnings, Timothy stubbornly kept Nancy in the house. Slowly but surely, cracks began to appear in their marriage..."

title: All Schemes Come to Nothing
description:
"Ethan Gould and Siofra Yeats maintained a seven-year platonic marriage, only for Ethan to discover that Siofra had an affair with her HIV-positive assistant, Morgan, and became pregnant. Siofra remained stubborn, smashed the cure, and was swindled out of three billion dollars. In the end, both she and her child contracted HIV, and Yeats Group teetered on the brink of bankruptcy.
 With the help of his schoolmate, Sydney, Ethan managed to reclaim control of Gould Corp and began a new chapter with Sydney. Meanwhile, Siofra, Morgan and the others spiraled into ruin, undone by betrayal and illness."

title: Revenge of XXL Wife
description: Maddie, a 250-pound housewife, is heartbroken when her husband Luke abandons her for his mistress, Olivia. Determined to rebuild her life, she undergoes a dramatic weight-loss transformation and emerges as a stunning, confident woman. With the help of Felix—her childhood friend, secret admirer, and now a billionaire—Maddie exacts a calculated revenge on Luke, Olivia, and even Luke’s manipulative mother.

title: （Dubbed）My Mercy Ends Here
description:
She hid her true identity and married him for three years, secretly clearing every obstacle in his business path.​
Until he forcibly took her blood to save his old flame—she handed him divorce papers and vanished without a trace.​
After the divorce, he finally discovered that the lifesaver he'd been searching for and the business benefactor behind his success were none other than the "ex-wife" he'd cast aside.​
At her engagement party, as he begged in utter disgrace, she simply raised her glass with a knowing smile:​
"Mr. Miller, your precious first love is waiting for you… in prison."

title: Her Silent Brilliance
description: Sherry Dawson, who suffers from aphasia, is forced to marry Regis Quinn, the son of the richest man in town, to save her bankrupted family. Soon, she discovers the Quinns are connected to her mother's death. Bound by a marriage contract, Sherry and Regis start out wary of each other, but gradually build trust as they work together to uncover the truth. Their investigation reveals that the mastermind is actually Regis's older brother, Hugh, whom Regis has always admired. Years ago, Hugh killed Sherry’s mother to seize the family fortune, faked a disability, and manipulated Regis ever since. In the end, Sherry regains her voice, and together with Regis, exposes Hugh's schemes and finds true love.

title: She's the Real Pearl
description: From billionaire to humble teacher—Richard Collins, Northwood's richest man, quietly molds his beloved daughter into success. But when she refuses to ghostwrite a paper for the dean's daughter, all hell breaks loose. Public humiliation in the bathroom, a humiliating livestream prank, and even having her clothes ripped off while false rumors swirl—all to test Richard's limits. The final blow? It's struck by someone from his own circle. When the truth explodes, the tables turn in a jaw-dropping identity reveal. Love and pride collide in an epic showdown—witness what happens when you mess with his daughter: "Cross her, and I'll flip the whole world upside down!"

title: （Dubbed）She's Back for Vengeance
description:
"Switched at birth, Diana is brought back to her wealthy family—only to become the outcast and meet a tragic end.
Reborn, she cuts all ties, exposes the fake heiress, and takes back everything.
But as she teams up with Charles for revenge, his gaze grows dangerously intense, and he whispers, ""Will you give me a chance to win your heart?""
——Welcome to Diana's Court. Let the judgment begin."

title: When the Mist Clears
description: This is a dramatic story of Dora and Gregory, a couple whose love began back in college and seemed headed for a happy marriage—until fate took a dark turn. After Dora is blinded in an accident while saving Gregory, she eventually regains her sight through surgery, only to discover that her fiancé has been cheating on her with his female friend, Romy. Heartbroken and betrayed, Dora decides to expose Gregory and Romy’s affair at the wedding. But that’s not all—on the same day, she stages her own fake funeral and vanishes, leaving Gregory to face the consequences of his actions. Meanwhile, at the funeral, Riley—the devoted young man who’s always cared for Dora—makes his move.

title: No Regrets, No Release
description: Wendy stood by Hayes from the lowest point of his startup days all the way to the peak of his career. For three years after their wedding, she devoted herself to being the perfect wife. But then, out of the blue, Wendy discovered intimate photos of Hayes with another woman, Shawn. Instead of confronting him right away, Wendy started keeping a scorecard, tracking Hayes's behavior as a husband. Hayes kept using work and business dinners as excuses to secretly meet up with Shawn. On their wedding anniversary, he even allowed Shawn to openly mock Wendy, leaving her completely heartbroken. After their divorce, Wendy launched her own design studio. Meanwhile, after being dumped by Shawn, Hayes finally woke up to what he'd lost. He began doing everything he could to win Wendy back, and with each genuine effort, the scores in Wendy's book slowly started to rise.

title: （Dubbed）Reborn: The Ultimate Father-in-Law
description:
"After his murder, billionaire Caleb wakes up three years earlier—to a time when his daughter is blinded by a hypocrite, and his son-in-law Henry is treated with contempt.
This time, he'll tear every lie apart, punish the traitors, and give everything to the only one who ever showed him loyalty: Henry.
But when the truth is finally revealed… will Henry's heart already be gone for good?
Can a second chance rewrite fate… or is some love lost forever?"

title: A Breath of Wind, A Fall of Sparks
description:
"Eleanor was neglected by her adoptive parents Robert and Laura in the Miller household. Their biological daughter, Chloe Miller, was hypocritical and malicious. Chloe killed Eleanor's husband, caused Eleanor's daughter Alice to have a life-threatening allergic reaction, and even arranged a car accident to kill Eleanor. After being reborn, Eleanor thwarted Chloe's schemes but was unfairly blamed. She then left the Millers with her family, found her biological father, changed her name to Eleanor Sterling, took over the Sterling Commerce Guild, and cut off all support for the Millers.



Her brother Daniel discovered Eleanor's diary and learned how she had secretly helped the family and how Chloe had conspired with a maid to commit evil deeds. The Millers realized their mistakes and apologized. Chloe hired an assassin to kill Eleanor, but Robert was severely injured while saving her. At a recognition banquet, Eleanor exposed Chloe's crimes, leading to her arrest. Eleanor stated that she held no grudges against the Millers but would no longer see them, starting a new life with her biological parents and loved ones instead."

description:
"I stayed in another world for Ethan, hiding his infertility and enduring IVF alone. The day I found out I was pregnant, I caught him at a prenatal check-up with his ""true love."" Heartbroken, my system awakened, and I left, taking our child with me.

Back in the real world, I focused on my career and fell in love with my childhood friend. Obsessed, Ethan chased after me, but my heart was already cold. Eventually, I exposed his true love's fake pregnancy, saw his family go bankrupt, and found happiness with my childhood sweetheart.

""Some loves, even the system deems unworthy of a second chance."""

title: The True Heiress Strikes Back
description:
"Switched at birth. Framed for Clara's crime. Eleanor spent three years in prison only to return to her family celebrating Clara's birthday.​
She just smiled and began her game—out-scheming the schemer, humiliating every enemy, clawing her way to the top. Just as Clara thought she'd won, the most powerful man in Imperial City stepped forward to claim Eleanor as his.
That's when Clara realized: the pushover heiress was gone. In her place stood a hunter.
— Did you think I was just the real heiress you could push around? No. I came back to judge you all."

title: One Night Stand with My Father's Killer
description:
After his tycoon father's death, Theodore's life falls apart. He escapes an attempted rape by a former friend, only to be rescued by Derek, with whom he shares a one-night stand. 
The next day, Theodore flees in panic—his first time with a man—and retreats to his only inheritance: a yacht moored off the Italian coast. There, he turns to drugs to numb his turmoil.
When Derek unexpectedly boards the yacht, Theodore, denying his attraction, orders him to leave. But as threats return, he must rely on Derek for protection. 
Their journey becomes a haze of drugs, desire, and growing tension—until Theodore uncovers a shocking truth: Derek may be linked to his father’s death.

title: （Dubbed）You Are My One and Only
description: After being diagnosed with cancer, Aurora makes a life-changing decision to divorce her unloving husband. One drunken night, she ends up in a passionate fling with Charles, the heir to the Harrison family. This ignites a tumultuous love story filled with drama, passion, and intense romance as Charles fights to win her heart...

title: （Dubbed）Kill Me, Save Me
description: After his girlfriend Emily King's tragic death, Noah Stark loses his sanity. He feigns recovery upon release from the hospital, carefully setting a web of revenge and turning Jerry Fox and Jade White against each other. When the truth comes to light, he faces justice—the cost he willingly pays for the love of his life.

title: （Dubbed）The Double Life of My Mysterious CEO
description: Emily Rain, drugged by her boss who owed her back wages, to get her money back,and married her swimming instructor, Alex Smith. Her life took a dramatic turn: she won a design competition and became a renowned jewelry designer for MP. She credited her success to hard work and luck, only to later discover that her husband was actually the CEO of MP.

title: Gaze into the Abyss
description:
"Steven left his wife Tessa for a chance with his first love, never realizing she was actually the heiress to the powerful Vance family.
When the Vance fortune quietly withdrew, his empire collapsed overnight. Now, desperate and begging for a second chance, he's met only with Tessa's cold rejection.
But that's not all—a new man from high society is pursuing her, and Steven's ex has returned with a hidden scheme.
Now, he's about to learn the hard way:
The wife he walked away from is now the woman he can never have back."

title: （Dubbed）The Grand Deception
description: After a planned car accident leaves heiress Chloe Hayes in a coma, her husband turns into a completely different person and enemies close in. Chloe, using her blindness and amnesia as a shield, navigates through constant peril. As the truth comes to light, deep betrayals and hidden secrets are revealed. In this ruthless world, can Chloe reclaim her life and outwit her enemies?

title: (Dubbed)From Cell to Cinderella
description: After a passionate night with Simon, the richest man in Emerald City, Diana finds herself falsely accused and thrown into jail. Ten months later, she gives birth to his son and pleads with her sister Molly to deliver the child to Simon. Upon receiving his son, Simon uncovers the heartbreaking struggles Diana has endured. Once Diana is released from prison, Simon showers her with love and together, they set out to crush their enemies and build a blissful future!

title: （Dubbed）Marrying My Jerk Ex's Dad
description: Grace accidentally slept with Andrew and was wracked with guilt over betraying her boyfriend. But then she found out that her boyfriend had been cheating on her with her best friend. In a fit of rage, Grace married Andrew, without a clue about who he really was...

When the company faces a crisis, Edward returns to help, but whether he forgives Jessica remains a mystery.

description:
Emily Carter is renowned throughout Westbridge University. A top academic achiever with exceptional beauty, yet from an impoverished background. For someone like her, her appearance isn't a blessing—it's original sin.

Alex Lowell was born at the pinnacle of the social pyramid. With his privileged family background and flawless appearance, he has everything—yet he's an absolute scoundrel.

These two people from entirely different worlds, who should have no connection whatsoever, were one day caught in an unexpected situation:

In Alex's Aston Martin, Emily was seen lifted with one arm onto his lap, her back pressed against the steering wheel. Through the interplay of light and shadow through the car windows, the man's pale, refined profile was clearly visible as he held her wrist, personally teaching her how to loosen his...

title: （Dubbed）My Flash-Marriage Bride
description: Molly marries the comatose Alexander to save her gravely ill grandmother, despite neither of them knowing each other. Eight months later, struggling to make ends meet while pregnant, Molly encounters Alexander again while delivering takeout. Unbeknownst to him, he starts to develop feelings for her. With a little push from his grandmother, they finally recognize each other. Molly gives birth to beautiful twins, and she and Alexander find lasting happiness together.

title: （Dubbed）Crack of Light
description: An unexpected night leaves George, driver for Clark Corp, in bed with Diana, heir to Percy Corp. Drawn to him, Diana makes George her personal driver and soon falls in love. But George harbors a dark secret—he's out for revenge against the Clark family. When Diana learns the truth, she chooses to marry Mr. Clark. With truth and lies tangled together, how will this love story born from deceit unfold...

title: （Dubbed）My Silent Farewell
description:
Diana is finally reunited with her wealthy biological parents after years in an orphanage, expecting a life of happiness.
Instead, she discovers Wendy, their beloved fake daughter who will stop at nothing to maintain her place.
Wendy's schemes reach a terrifying level when she frames Diana by pushing her fiancé's sister down the stairs, leaving her in a coma.
In court, Diana's parents delete crucial footage and her brother falsely testifies, sending her to prison for five brutal years.Released and determined to cut ties, she's hardened, ready to leave them forever.
But now, her family suddenly wants her back...

title: My Ice-Cold CEO Wife
description: He is the legendary "Grim Reaper"—a war machine who makes the underworld tremble in terror. After a life-altering incident, he returns to the city and enters a marriage of convenience with an ice-cold female CEO. This is a story about living boldly, breaking the rules, and rewriting the game on your own terms.

title: Her Deadly Game
description:
"Back from studying abroad, she was framed by her own brother and his wife—disfigured, silenced, robbed of everything.
Emerging from hell, she wields silence as her blade, tearing off every mask of hypocrisy.
She reclaims her company, crushes her enemies, and joins forces with the powerful CEO of Ford Corporation.
By the time karma claims the wicked, she has already risen from the ashes—crowned and unbroken.
""You could destroy my face, but everything that's mine—I'll take it all back with my own hands."

title: A Recipe for Revenge
description: Master Chef Grace was murdered and reborn as the stand-in for CEO Charles's beloved. She hid her talent, but her incredible culinary skills couldn't stay a secret for long. When their contract ended, she turned to leave, but the cold, stoic man cornered her, his eyes burning with emotion. "The taste... I know it's you," he said. This time, she's determined to reclaim not only her title as a Master Chef, but also the life stolen by her backstabbing friend and ex-boyfriend.

description:
On her deathbed, a powerful matriarch discovers her greatest mistake—protecting the wrong woman and losing her true family. 
Given a second chance, Sophia wakes three years in the past, determined to shield her loyal daughter-in-law and rewrite their fate. 
This time, Sophia'll stop at nothing to protect the love and happiness her family deserves.

title: （DUBBED）His Light in the Dark
description:
"Cecilia, a dedicated urologist, marries into the powerful Russell family to save her sick mother, becoming the wife of Aiden, Emerald City's richest man. On their wedding night, she encounters Aiden's enigmatic younger brother, Austin. Torn between Aiden's cold demeanor and Austin's gentle nature, Cecilia soon uncovers a shocking truth: Austin is actually a manifestation of Aiden's split personality, rooted in a traumatic kidnapping incident from seventeen years ago.
As Cecilia digs deeper, she discovers that Aiden's uncle, Simon, was involved in the kidnapping. Together, she and Aiden confront Simon, work through Aiden's trauma, and help integrate his fractured identities. Through their journey of healing and redemption, they rekindle love, overcome their crises, and restore peace to the Russell family."

title: Contract's End, Prey's Fate
description: George's unrequited love for Julia turns into a tumultuous marriage, arranged by her father to keep her away from her true love, Ethan. Despite George's dedication, Julia's heart belongs to Ethan. When Julia unexpectedly becomes pregnant after Ethan's return, secrets and heartbreak unfold. A tragic misunderstanding breaks them apart, and George leaves devastated. But when Julia's world falls apart, she discovers George is her last hope. Can she win him back or has she lost him forever to another woman?

title: Mr. Vance's Lost Body
description: It's a corporate showdown, a family feud, a fierce brotherly battle for inheritance, and a high-stakes economic duel among tycoons. But when a freak soul swap turns their world upside down, the fight for family dominance explodes like never before...

title: Against the Light
description:
"Isabella Williams is the perfect heiress, but her tragic past hides deep scars: her father's murder and mother's suicide, caused by Owen Reed's obsession. Now living under a false name, she plans her escape from the Reed family.

When she rescues Henry, the Northern Faction leader, from a fake assassination attempt, he falls for her instantly. She sees him as her only way out. As he helps her face her dark past, she can't help but fall for him too..."

title: After the Divorce, the Heiress Takes It All
description: After divorcing her indecisive husband, the mysterious writer Dorothy chose to prove herself through her talent — she created her most important work, silenced her jealous sister-in-law, and finally found her true love.

title: (DUBBED)Darkness Before Dawn
description: Vicky, a wealthy heiress, marries penniless Ethan and soon becomes pregnant. A tragic accident on her delivery day kills her parents, causes her to lose her baby, and leaves her mentally impaired. For six years, she's in a wheelchair, cared for by Ethan and her best friend. But a sudden recovery reveals their affair and the shocking truth: her condition was their doing. Now, Vicky is determined to make them pay and uncover the mystery behind the car accident!

title: （DUBBED）The Pinnacle Club
description: Bella and her sister Molly have always relied on each other. Molly's future looked bright with her plans to study abroad, but everything came crashing down when she fell naked to her death from the Sterling Corporation building. The brutal truth? The chairman raped her, and his son pushed her. Yet, thanks to their immense power, the Sterlings walked free, the case ruled an accident. Devastated, Bella vows to take them down, only to be manipulated by Ethan, the chairman's illegitimate son, who sees her as the perfect weapon against his own family. Thrust into a world of wealth and dark secrets, Bella uses her rage to fuel family infighting. But as sparks fly between her and Ethan, and just when she thinks she's achieved her revenge, she realizes the real storm is only just beginning…

title: Crown Myself
description: After a car accident leaves Victoria paralyzed and her boyfriend George disappears from her life, she discovers his true colors. Ready for revenge, she stops hiding her wealthy heiress status and takes back everything that's rightfully hers...

title: (DUBBED)An Ocean Away
description:
On their three-year anniversary, what awaited her wasn't a proposal ring, but a lipstick stain on his collar.
As her hopes turned to dust, Cecilia received an offer from a top-tier corporation—and a clear view of what their "love" really was.**​
She turned away without hesitation, leaving the heartbreak behind, and sharpened her edge in a foreign workplace.
Meanwhile, the once-indifferent ex began desperately searching for any trace of her.
By the time he was consumed with regret, she was already shining bright, standing shoulder-to-shoulder with someone who matched her stride.**​
This is a story about cutting losses in time and making a brilliant turn—sometimes, you have to let go of the wrong person, so the world can bring the right one to you.

title: [Dubbled]Mr. Sterling's Fiery Sweetheart
description: Seven years ago, Grace stumbled mistakenly into the hotel room of Damien, the enigmatic CEO of Sterling Group. That one passionate night resulted in twin boys. In a cruel twist of fate, her eldest son was stolen and abandoned, leaving only little Leo by her side. Fast forward seven years, and Grace returns home with Leo, determined to find her lost son. When she unexpectedly crosses paths with Damien once more, sparks fly, but neither recognizes the other... What will happen when the truth comes to light?

It seems as if Ethan's "soul" has taken over Aiden, who knows every detail of Chloe's life with Ethan. Torn and confused, Chloe struggles to accept this unexpected twist of fate...

description: On the day of Sophie’s wedding, she discovers that her fiancé Andy is cheating on her with her own sister Ella! To make matters worse, she finds out that she is actually the adopted daughter of the Martin family. Staring at the twisted family my husband and aunt had built upon my stolen motherhood, a sudden, icy numbness quieted my shattered world. 
"Call me Mom one last time," I whispered through the ash and tears, "and I promise I'll never bother you again."

title: Sleeping With the Boss
description:
For eighteen months, I was Adam Sterling’s secret lover.
By day, I taught his seven-year-old daughter French. By night, I warmed his bed.
He gave me a luxury apartment, expensive jewelry—everything but a commitment.
I thought I was his woman… until his ex-wife came back. That’s when I understood—I was just a high-end toy.
Used in front of her, then thrown away like trash.
I fled to Paris, carrying his child.
Now he says he loves me, that it’s real this time.
But the girl who used to get wet from just one look from him?
She's gone.

title: Seven Years in a Dream, Awake at Las
description:
On our wedding night, my husband wanted to play a game.
Trade secrets. The kind that could destroy you if they ever got out.
He went first.
"I hurt a girl once. At a ski lodge. She shouldn't have been in that room. But she was."
He said it like a parking ticket. Then he took a sip of whiskey and moved on.
My turn.
"I killed someone," I said. "Do you believe me?"
He laughed. He thought I was joking.
He really shouldn't have kissed me after that.

title: Abandoned as a Fool, I Became the Math Queen
description:
At the scene of the car accident, my parents frantically scooped up my sister—who only had a scraped knee—then kicked me aside as I lay there dying.
"Don't be a burden to your sister. Just wait by the roadside and croak!"
They drove off without a second thought. In that moment, my heart turned to stone.
What they didn't know was that I didn't die. Instead, I got adopted by a top-tier professor and became a math prodigy worth tens of millions.
Two years later, when my birth parents went bankrupt and got on their knees begging me for a handout, I smiled coldly and played the recording of their attempted murder...

title: The Nobody He Killed Was Royalty
description:
My serpent mate has locked me in the castle, nine months pregnant. A dozen serpent guards watch me day and night. I can't even leave the room.
A month ago, his brother died in a hunting accident. He became the serpent clan leader. Then he brought back his brother's widow, the woman he grew up with. His first love.
He said he needed to take care of his brother's widow. He told me we'd all live together in the castle, nice and peaceful.
I said no.
I'm his mate. I'm a beastman. My pride won't let me accept that. And they grew up together, childhood sweethearts. How could I not think about it?
She came to him in tears, heavily pregnant. She said I poisoned her medicine, that I wanted to kill her and the baby.
He believed her.
He decided I was just some rogue beastman with no background, jealous and vicious, only after his title and money. So he locked me in this freezing castle while he camped outside her delivery room.
When labor hit, I screamed for a healer. I swore I never hurt her. I just couldn't live with her under the same roof. I only ever loved him.
He just laughed. "You're good at acting. I don't believe a word out of you. Once she delivers safely, I'll deal with you. Don't think you can trick me into coming back."
But when a trembling guard reported "Your mate and the child... they didn't make it," he lost it completely.

title: He Won't Stop Kissing My Skin
description:

My turn.
