title: Cursed Bride of the Shadow Lord
description:
At my seventh wedding, they replaced me.
The Oracle pointed at me and screamed one word: "CURSED."
Father's hand cracked across my face. Mother tore the wedding dress off my body and shoved my cousin Seraphine into it.
"She'll marry him instead," Father said. "You'll destroy us all."
What they didn't know? A thousand years ago, our family made a blood pact with the Shadow Lord himself: if the eldest Ashford daughter remained unmarried on her twenty-sixth birthday, she belonged to HIM.
Today was my twenty-sixth birthday.
I begged Julian to run. "Please. We have until sunset."
He laughed. "The Shadow Lord's a fairy tale, Anna. Seraphine's just going through the motions. You're being dramatic."
Then he told my parents everything.
They locked me in the tower.
But the Shadow High Priest's warning was clear—at sunset, the Shadow Lord would come. And when he did, I'd drink the Potion of Forgetting and lose everything.
My memories. My name. My soul.
The clock struck five.
He was coming.

title: The Vampire Queen They Sacrificed
description:
I was dying, but honestly? Death felt like mercy.
As a vampire, I should have been immortal. But at six years old, I'd made a deal with a demon, gambling my fate on "true love"—if three times I failed to win the heart of the one I loved, the demon would claim my soul.
Just when I thought death was certain, I got pregnant. Morag, the demon, showed rare mercy, promising to wait until I gave birth.
But at eight months, my husband sneered about removing the "bastard." My brother didn't even flinch as he sliced open my belly. My parents cursed that I deserved it—all to save my sister Lycia, who'd somehow "returned from the dead."
The day they cut my child out, not one tear. Not for me.
So why, after I died, were they all on their knees at my grave, sobbing?

title: The Gentle Wife Next Door
description:
A young couple recently moved in right across the hall from us. 
The husband, Richard, works as an auditor at City Hall. His wife, Chloe, is the morning show host for a local TV network. 
Chloe is about five-foot-three, with curves in all the right places. Her entire being radiates an unignorable, mature housewife charm—she is absolutely gorgeous. 
Richard is a serious whiskey enthusiast and often invites me over to the patio for a couple of drinks, so our families quickly grew close. My wife, Sarah, and Chloe, in particular, became like sisters the moment they started talking about Sephora's new releases and luxury bags. They could easily gossip for an entire weekend. 
And that... gave me an opportunity.

title: After the 99th Stand-Up, He Lost His Mind
description: After being stood up for the ninety-ninth time while attempting to register for marriage, I sent my fiancé a breakup message. He had allowed me to be let down ninety-nine times, dismissing my asthma as mere pretentiousness and perceiving my sacrifices as acts of greed, all the while lavishing his patience upon another woman. It was only when he had his mistress select a cheap necklace for me and sketched explicit nudes of her that I realized these seven years were not a narrative of profound love, but rather an absurd farce playing out solely in my life. The moment I dispatched the breakup message, I never envisioned that this man, who viewed me as dispensable, would later pursue me with a frenzied obsession.

title: Until I Forgot to Love You
description:
I thought I was the perfect wife and mother, until I heard my husband outside his office, laughing, calling me a "prison warden" and planning to use our daughter as cover while he ran off to Tuscany with his grad student.
Everything fell apart. Then my daughter, in front of everyone: "That's just our annoying nanny."
I tried to hold on to what was left of our family, but my daughter shoved me down the stairs. I lost the baby, and my husband just checked his watch while I bled out on the floor.
They locked me in and left for Italy.
Alone in the hospital, they told me I'd lost the baby and had "memory damage."
Now they're back, expecting the same obedient wife.
She's gone.
And I'm done loving them.

title: When Love Goes Silent
description:
I clutched my pregnancy test results in my hand, standing outside the door of Ethan's office.
I wanted to surprise my husband with this news.
Instead, I overheard a conversation about how to "permanently remove" me from his and our daughter's lives.

title: My Cold Stepbrother is the Only Cure
description:
The remote vacation villa was saturated with suffocating male testosterone.
Deep in the night, my life-saving suppressants inexplicably vanished. The moment the drugs wore off, my unspeakable secret—my sex addiction—unleashed its most violent, lethal backlash in history.
What was even more fatal was that, through a twisted twist of fate, the man I was forced to share a room with tonight was my stepbrother, renowned for his absolute abstinence and cold, iron-fisted ruthlessness.
I thought that once my embarrassingly out-of-control, in-heat state was exposed, he would treat me like a monster and kick me away in disgust.
But I never expected—
This aloof man, who usually wouldn't even spare me a glance, now carried an irresistible, scorching aggression, ruthlessly sliding his large, rough hand straight up my thoroughly soaked panties...

title: A Policewoman’s Tale
description: I’m Emily, a criminal investigator in Emerald City. After a vice crackdown, I refused a transfer—only to realize someone was tailing me on my way home at night…

title: My Blood Fed His First Love
description:
On our third wedding anniversary, a catastrophic car accident plunged me into a state of life-threatening hemorrhage. Yet, before the medical staff, my husband roared: "Draw my wife's blood first; save Serena." 
Serena—his first love.
It became apparent that he had never married me out of love; I was but a living blood bank, intended solely to sustain his cherished first love. It was only when I discovered I was pregnant that I realized he would not even spare the life within me.
That incarceration, cloaked in the guise of love, had nearly claimed my life. When I opened my eyes again, I was no longer the Clara who could be so easily sacrificed. This time, I shall ensure he pays for his blood debt, with no chance of redemption.

title: Harvested for My Adopted Sister's Heart
description:
Six months after our bonding ceremony, I was ambushed by rogue wolves while searching for rare herbs in the Black Forest.
Their poisoned claws shredded my abdomen—and with it, any chance of ever carrying pups.
But my mate held my hand and wept. My mother swore she'd save me. My father said everything would be fine.
How pathetic—
Right before they wheeled me into surgery, I heard them through a cracked door, calmly discussing how to harvest my heart for the adopted sister who'd been waiting six months.
Turns out the "accident" was a gift from my loving family of four.
Turns out the last six months of "coming home" was just them fattening up my heart for harvest.
What they don't know? The voice memo on my phone caught everything.
What they really don't know? Six months from now, I'm coming back—
With a Dark Moon Alliance badge. And a heart much colder than the one they stole.
Shh. Listen.
That stolen heart? It's starting to reject.

title: My Fiancé's Mistress Tried to Strip-Search Me
description:
I came back to New York for one reason: to meet the man my mother arranged for me to marry.
I never made it to dinner.
His "sister"—the woman he'd been protecting since childhood, the one he clearly loved more than he'd ever love a fiancée he'd never met—snatched a twelve-thousand-dollar dress out of my hands at a Fifth Avenue boutique and had me thrown out. When I called him about it, he told me I should be grateful to be marrying into his family at all. Then he hung up.
An hour later, she accused me of stealing her ring. Had me pinned against the wall. Told his men to strip me down and film it for "evidence."
Nico laughed when I told him the whole Ferrante family would answer for this.
"With what? You?"
My name is Sera Vitti.
That's all I'll say.

title: A Teacher's Downfall
description:
"Miss Smith, I think I can smell your scent... it's so womanly..."
I looked down at the boy hiding under the lectern, watching helplessly as he had his way with me right there in the classroom, while I had to pretend everything was normal...



My name is Catherine, the university math teacher. With my husband always away on business trips, at thirty years old, I was like a nun guarding that double bed, never satisfied. Slowly, I developed some strange habits... and became bolder...



The bell for the end of class had just rung, and teachers and students were flocking to the bathrooms in groups, chattering noisily outside.



In one of the bathroom stalls, I was panting, squatting... my black lace panties down around my ankles, my face flushed with ecstasy as I indulged...

title: Crashed, Cheated, Caught
description:
Three years after my pilot husband "died" in a plane crash, I walk in on him cutting a birthday cake for his three-year-old son backstage at the company memorial gala.
Luke freezes in the lounge, his hand still on the knife, staring at me.
His parents rush over to shield him. The same couple who screamed at me in the funeral home, wishing I'd died instead of him.
"Nora, just calm down. There's an explanation..."
Claire covers her slightly rounded belly, tears streaming down her face. "I'm so sorry, Nora. My baby needs his father. Please, I'm begging you. I couldn't help myself—I love him."
I thought I'd break down. Thought I'd scream.
But all that guilt, all that self-blame, three years of missing him burns away the second I see the truth.
Nothing's left.

title: Divorcing My Mafia Husband at His Second Wedding
description:
Married to the head of the Valenti family for five years. Kidnapped on our anniversary. Pregnant a month later.
Five paternity tests said the baby wasn't his. My husband got a vasectomy and swore he'd raise the child as his own.
I believed him.
Then came the therapy. The drugs. Nightmares where I was pinned down by multiple men, so real I could feel their hands hours after waking. I scrubbed my skin raw. Tried to end it six times.
He saved me every time. Held my hand. Told me no one would ever hurt me again.
Until the night I heard him laughing about it in his study.
The kidnapping was staged. The nightmares were chemicals. The DNA reports were forged. All of it — designed by my own husband to protect another woman.
Now I have a recording, a divorce agreement, and a very small box of ashes.
He's marrying her next week. I'll make sure he gets my wedding gift on time.

title: The Forbidden Flight Service
description:
Look, I'd heard the rumors: Skyward International's flight attendants? You never see 'em anywhere but the airport. Not once. Kinda spooky, but my coworker drops this smirk—"First time? You'll get it"—and I'm boarding Flight 6108, heart pounding.

This chief stewardess, Tiffany? Stunning. Locks eyes, buckles me in, perfume hits like a drug. Later, service cart rolls up. "Airsick? C'mon." Door shuts in the crew lounge. Boom—she's on her knees. "Relaxation service." Zipper down, wipes me clean, then swallows my cock whole. Balls-deep, tongue on my sack, cheeks sucking vacuum. "Big one," she whispers, eyes pleading like she needs my okay.

title: I Was Dead While They Cut the Cake
description:
While I bled to death locked in a storage room, my fiancé Adrian was holding my sister's hand, comforting her.
He hung up on my final call for help, leaving only a voicemail: "If anything happens to Lena, the engagement is off."
My sister once said her birthday wish had always been for me to disappear.
That night, her wish came true early.
But my soul never left.
I watched everyone gather around her, singing happy birthday.
As she blew out the candles, I whispered in her ear:
"Enjoy it while it lasts. This will be your last birthday."

title: Go Save Your Sweetheart
description:
Ambushed by a rival syndicate. My mafia husband had to choose — save me, or save his childhood sweetheart.
I was five months pregnant with his heir. She was the love of his life.
He chose me. She died.
He said it was fine. Took time off work. Bought out every baby store in the city. Made me warm milk every night.
I thought I'd finally won his heart.
Until the day our son was born. He carried our baby to her grave.
My son never came back.
"You thought you won? The day she died, you were already dead to me. I just needed the heir first."
Then he had me beaten to death beside her tombstone.
When I opened my eyes again, I was back in that ambush.
This time, I let go of his sleeve.
Go save your sweetheart. I'm done begging.

title: My Perfect Husband's Betrayal
description:
Everyone says I married the perfect husband—considerate, devoted, loving.
I thought I had happiness too, until my neighbor told me she'd seen "me" having sex with Declan multiple times over the summer, even against the floor-to-ceiling windows. But during those two months, I'd been with my son out of town the entire time.
I rushed home and heard 8-year-old Beckett on the phone, bragging to his father: "Dad, I got Mom out of the way for two whole months. Did you make up with your sweetheart? Where's my allowance?"
I pulled up the security footage and saw a woman wearing my nightgown, with my husband, in every corner of our home... I spent eight years building this family, and they betrayed me together.

title: In the Gym
description:
My husband, Arthur, forced me to take private training sessions with his buddy Marcus, saying my body wasn’t good enough for him to really enjoy himself in bed. But on the very first day, Marcus started getting handsy with me.
“Coach, stop. I’m here to work out, not have an affair,” I bit back a moan, trying to push away the “help” he was giving me with my squats.
What I didn’t expect was for him to start rubbing his thing against my pussy.

title: The Captain's Forbidden Cure
description:
No one knew I was an addict. 
Not to alcohol, not to drugs, but to the rawest, dirtiest kind of union. 
To keep up the facade of this respectable job, to stop myself from turning into some desperate, heat-crazed stray begging for a man’s touch on the street, I had to swallow those little blue pills every day. 
Until that damn blizzard trapped me with thirty hockey players reeking of sweat and testosterone, and my pills—gone.

title: His Caged Bird Doesn't Beg
description:
Everyone in our circle knows I'm Adrian's caged bird, and the "bad woman" his son Miles hates most.
For Miles, I gave up my fellowship in Zurich and spent seven years playing housewife.
What did I get in return? Adrian took Sophie to gallery openings on our anniversary. Miles smashed cake in my face in front of everyone, calling me a frumpy housewife.
Adrian was certain I couldn't leave him. Certain I couldn't leave our son.

He threw the divorce papers on the table with a cold smile. "Sign this, and you lose everything. Including Miles."
He expected me to beg on my knees.
I didn't.
I picked up the pen and signed without hesitation.
"Fine, Adrian. You keep Miles. And I get to keep myself."
For just a moment, I saw shock flash in his eyes.
I heard later that Adrian searched for me like a madman, and the son he doted on cried and screamed for his mommy.
Too bad. I'd already burned it all down myself.

title: I Left the Mafia Don, Married His Rival
description:
I'm an OB-GYN. On Valentine's Day, I pulled a ring out of a woman's vagina.
It turned out to be my husband's wedding ring.
An hour before, he'd texted me. Said he loved me. Said he was too busy with work to come home.
I wanted a divorce. Needed one. But then I found out—our marriage was never registered.
In his manor, I was nothing. Just a fake wife.
He grabbed me by the throat—right in front of his mistress. Called me "damaged goods." Said I'd spent a year in another man's house.
But that year, I went as a hostage in his place.
I ran. Made it to the cliff's edge, covered in blood. And the man who saved me? The mafia godfather who'd held me captive that whole year.
He looked at me. "Marry me."

title: Marking the Alpha My Cousin Couldn't Tame
description: woke up twenty-three again, and the first thing I did was steal my cousin’s mating contract. In my last life, I watched her fade into a ghost wife, unbonded and unloved for fifty years. Not this time. I drove across the country to claim Kaelen Thornfield—the coldest, most powerful Alpha in the West. He expected a submissive mate; I gave him grease-stained arms and a bite to the neck. "Marks aren't given. They're taken," I told his shocked pack. Now, I’m tearing off the mask of his "innocent" mistress and teaching this Alpha that I don't just follow the bond—I own it.

title: Go Save Your Precious, I'll Save Myself
description: I spent five years paying for a mistake I didn't make. In my last life, my fiancé Callum chose to save me instead of the woman he loved—and he made me suffer for it every day until we both died at the bottom of the ocean. Now, I’ve woken up on that same island, at the moment of the crash. This time, I’m giving him what he wants. "Take her and go," I told him, watching as he abandoned me to a wild bear without looking back. But I’m not a victim anymore. I’m saving myself, and the mysterious man who rescues me has no intention of ever letting me go back to the monster who left me to die.

title: Murdered by the Man I Loved
description: I jumped into the freezing lake to save my husband’s mistress, only to realize it was a deadly trap. While I struggled for air, my husband, Eric, watched from the shore, convinced by his mistress that I was the one trying to kill her. He ordered the cage locked, drowning me and our unborn child in the shallow water. But as my body was dragged from the mud, the truth came out: the mistress staged it all to steal my life. Now, Eric is kneeling in the rain, staring at the blood on his own hands. He didn't just lose a wife; he murdered his own future.

title: Ashes of Love the Mafia Don‘ s Regret
description: On our daughter’s seventh birthday, my husband was at a prenatal checkup with his mistress. While he rained rose petals from a helicopter for her, I was signing a cremation certificate. He offered me three million dollars to hand over custody, unaware that the "Anna" he wanted was already in a stone urn on the conference table. "The last thing she asked was: 'Why won't Daddy come see me?'" I whispered as his world shattered. He chose the killer over his own blood, and now, I will make sure he loses everything—his heir, his mistress, and his soul.

title: I Took a Bullet He took a Mistress
description:
Seven years ago, I took a bullet to save Vincent Caruso’s life. My reward? A cold guest room, a husband who smelled of another woman's perfume, and a mistress carrying his heir. While I endured the pain of my scars, Vincent was promising the world to Serena. 
He thought I was the "perfect wife" who would never leave—until I vanished. I left behind two broken rings and a ghost of the woman who nearly died for him. Now, as his empire crumbles and he begs for my return, he’ll realize some wounds never heal, and some women never look back.

title: When Hearts Ring
description: An adorable sign language translator and a cold, aloof lawyer—a loveless married couple in an arranged marriage for three years, distant on the surface but hiding deep feelings for each other!

title: Fired the Wrong Man
description:
"Tyler Scott, a brilliant bridge designer, was personally recruited by the chairman of James Corp after repeated invitations to join the company as Chief Engineer. He played a key role in elevating James Corp to the top of the industry, only to be unexpectedly fired by the chairman's daughter, Sienna.
 After leaving James Corp, Tyler joined its rival, Hightide Realty, where he used his expertise to help the company strike back and bring James Corp down."

title: She Rose Like the Sun
description:
[The Wife Who Survived & the Current Mrs. Yancy Who's Cornered—Two Women, One Husband, and Both Want Him Dead!]
Zach Yancy clawed his way up the social ladder by murdering his wife for insurance money. But Linda, the ex-wife he thought was long dead, survived—and now she's back. Step by step, she shatters Chloe—the Current Mrs. Yancy's—fantasy of a perfect marriage. What starts as hostility between two women turns into an uneasy alliance as they join forces to rip apart Zach's carefully crafted mask. Together, they expose his lies, take back what was stolen from them, and make him pay for every last thing he did. A high-stakes revenge story packed with twists, mind games, and ruthless payback—girls helping girls is more than just a slogan!

title: The Day I Stopped Waiting
description: On her 25th wedding anniversary, Ainsley finds a silk gown on the coffee table. She thinks it’s a gift from her husband. It’s actually for her best friend—his mistress of 25 years. He screams at her to strip it off. Then he slams her head into the table. “Lick the blood off the floor,” he orders. Her six-year-old grandson throws a milk bottle at her chest: “You’re just the maid.” Her son smirks in the doorway: “You don’t work. How else do you justify staying?” That night, Ainsley calls the one person she abandoned for love—a number she hasn’t dialed in 25 years. A low voice on the other end says, “I’ll arrange everything.” The next morning, Ainsley walks into the kitchen as usual and brews coffee for the whole family. Only this time, there’s a small, unreadable smile on her lips.

title: He Left Me in Labor to Help His Ex
description:
"Sarah was in active labor, contractions hitting hard, only four miles from the hospital. But her husband Ethan stopped the car—and locked her inside—just to help his ex-girlfriend carry groceries in the rain.
Her water broke. She begged for help. He ignored her. She nearly died escaping through the trunk, gave birth alone, and fought for her baby’s life.
When she needed him most, he was busy comforting his ex, buying her luxury bags, and even choosing her over his own wife and newborn during a violent robbery.
Broken and cold, Sarah decided to leave. But Ethan refused to let go—until she uncovered a shocking secret that would destroy him completely."

title: Axed the Ace
description: "Salley Levit, a programming genius personally recruited by the chairman after multiple attempts, got fired by Sharon Carter—the chairman's daughter who just took over. After a series of screw-ups, Sharon mixed up Salley, the company's backbone, with Sully Levitt, the corporate leech. Sully played her like a fiddle, turning her against Salley. Fed up with the BS, Salley jumped ship to their rival, Apex Tech. As the two companies went head-to-head, Sharon kept backing the wrong horse—trusting that hack Sully—and tanked the new project completely. Meanwhile, Apex Tech shot straight to the top with Salley on their team.

title: Medical Pioneer: Reborn
description: Renowned medical pioneer Sean Gordon developed a revolutionary cancer cure, only to find himself abruptly transported fifty years into the past. Determined to save his mother, and driven by a mission to heal the world, he resolved to introduce the life-saving drug decades ahead of its time. But such an advanced discovery, far beyond the era's scientific understanding, was met with intense skepticism and doubt. Through relentless rounds of clinical trials, Sean gradually earned widespread recognition and emerged as a visionary leader in medicine, spearheading a new wave of medical revolution.

title: （Dubbed）Secret on the Yoga Mat
description: "Sophia believed her first love's lies, watched her daughter in danger and did nothing, convinced her husband George was a greedy fraud. Then the truth exploded—the man she despised was the silent force behind her success, while the one she trusted was stealing George's research and her fortune. By the time she understood, it was too late: George had moved on with the woman who always loved him, and her daughter had happily found a new mom. Left with nothing but regret, she realized some wounds never heal. ""The one you pushed away was the only one who ever held you up."

title: The Wife's Calculated Move
description: Betrayed by his wife and her lover, and murdered by his own son, Daniel is given a second chance at life. Back from the brink, he's out for vengeance—determined to make his enemies pay in blood. With cunning traps and shocking reveals, Daniel exposes the web of lies, turning greed against itself. As his betrayers fall into ruin, Daniel finds hope and a new beginning with the one person who truly cares. This time, he's taking control of his destiny—no one will stand in his way.

title: From Zero, Her Plea
description:
"Tech mogul Daniel Lewis was poisoned by his sister Emily and her boyfriend Jason, only to be reborn at the critical moment of his father's terminal illness and the impending inheritance division. Facing his equally reborn, power-hungry sister Emily, he deliberately ceded control of Lewis Innovations—riddled with financial loopholes—taking only his father's entrepreneurial journal. Using insights from the journal and memories from his past life, Daniel traded stocks to raise seed capital, rapidly growing Cosmos Technologies and catching the attention of investment queen Diana Sterling, who soon became a key partner.
 Meanwhile, Emily struggled to steer Lewis Innovations toward success. After stealing Daniel’s plans for The Everest Project, she fell right into his trap. Through clashes at tech expos and financing meetings, Daniel outmaneuvered her at every turn, igniting a high-stakes battle over family assets, cutting-edge projects, and long-simmering revenge."

title: (DUBBED)Back to the 80s: Making My Fortune
description: Wealthy hairdressing mogul Amelia accidentally time-travels to the 1980s, becoming the neighborhood "nuisance." Her scientist husband Luke originally wanted a divorce but was always refused. Now, it's Amelia who's determined to leave him. As she focuses on making money, Luke pleads with her, saying, "If we get divorced, where will I find a wife as good as you?"

title: Father and Son: The Dragon’s Rivalry
description: In the concrete jungle of the city, former world champion Damian hides, burdened by the tragic loss of his wife and his own crippling injury. Twelve years later, a new dark force emerges, and his son Leo becomes an unwilling pawn in a deadly game. Will Damian rise again to fight for his family and honor against long-standing hatred and conspiracy? This is a tale packed with suspense and emotion, where power, deceit, and family collide at every turn. Join us to uncover the truth and witness the fearless comeback of a legendary fighter.

title: Claimed by My Alpha Stepfather
description:
Lyra was hopelessly in love with her stepfather Magnus—the handsome, powerful Alpha—but could only watch helplessly as he bedded other women.

When she tried to distance herself with a shattered heart, fate dealt her a devastating blow. An accident left Magnus out of control, and he brutally claimed her.

Though she was the victim of rape, she was branded as the whore who "seduced her stepfather"!

Silver whips tore through her flesh, leaving her bloodied and broken. When Lyra knelt in her own blood, begging for mercy, the man who once vowed to protect her for life coldly commanded—

"Continue the punishment."

Four years later, just when she thought she had finally escaped her past, Magnus reappeared. Seeing her pregnant with another man's child, his eyes burned with insane possessiveness:

"You can never leave me."

title: Killed by My Scumbag Husband, Reborn to Marry His Alpha Father
description:
My worthless husband murdered me in cold blood, along with our six-month-old unborn child.
Reborn at my own mating ceremony, I boldly rejected the weakling ex who couldn't even complete his wolf transformation, and shocked everyone by proposing to his powerful Alpha father!

"Alpha Dominic, make me your Luna! I'll give the Storm Pack the true Alpha heirs they deserve!"

The entire pack was stunned—a lowly Omega from nowhere just shattered centuries of tradition!

But when I conceived Alpha triplets, the werewolf world exploded. A miracle that happens once in a lifetime!

title: My Familiar is a Chick... But It's Apollo!
description:
Trojan princess Cassandra thought she had everything. The strongest bonded beast. Her closest sister. Then Troy burned, a million souls perished, and she learned the truth: her cherished Pegasus and Helen had been working together to destroy her all along.
She opened her eyes once again. Reborn to the day she chooses her beast. This time, she walks right past Pegasus. This time, while everyone laughs, she picks a little yellow chick.

title: Forbidden Affair: Taming the Dragon Lord
description: Sora, a maiden blessed with Holy Blood, is abducted into the Dragon Palace as a breeding tool for a tyrannical Dragon King. Lucius, the empire's most ruthless Black Dragon warlord, is tasked with intimately "training" her to endure the scorching dragon breath.  Amidst forbidden touches and lethal temptations, Sora uses herself as bait, pushing the stoic warrior to the brink of insanity until he willingly surrenders his sacred Heart Scale just to keep her safe. But when she strikes down the tyrant and falls critically wounded—driving Lucius into a bloodthirsty frenzy—she awakens as the Supreme Dragon Mother as ten thousand dragons bow before her.  Who is truly taming whom? A dangerously addictive forbidden desire has spiraled out of control.

title: Yes！The Lord of My Blood
description: Orphaned hunter Ella slips into an ancient castle to find her missing boyfriend — and accidentally wakes Kane, a primordial vampire who's slept for a thousand years. He blackmails her with the one life she cares about, binding her to a blood thrall contract. But as his vampiric hold tightens, Ella uncovers a truth that shatters everything: the Hunter's Guild she idolized is built on lies — her boyfriend was using her as bait, and the Guild Master murdered her parents. When her world collapses, Kane rips out his own cursed heart to shield her, carving a path through their enemies in blood. In that desperate hour, Ella's dormant primordial blood ignites. She ends the traitor and the hypocrite with her own hands, then rebuilds Kane's heart from the pieces. From thrall to sovereign, Ella rises as a half-vampire queen who bends the ancient Kane to her will — and together, they claim the Kingdom of Night.

title: Touch Me Tender,My Dark Lord
description: For three hundred years, Seraphina—Heaven’s deadliest warrior—has wanted only one thing: Lucifer’s death. But when she loses to the Lord of Hell and becomes his prisoner, she uncovers an impossible secret—the demon she hates has been protecting her all along. As Heaven’s betrayal comes to light, hatred ignites into forbidden desire, forcing two mortal enemies to fight side by side against the conspiracy that started the war.

title: Surrender to me, Lord Lucifer
description:
On the day of her eighteenth Wing Coronation, Ella, daughter of the Archangel, is forced into marriage with the Lord of Hell himself—Lucifer, a fallen angel who once betrayed Heaven. She would rather die than submit, but when her younger sister's life is used as leverage, she has no choice but to comply.

In Hell, Lucifer must assert dominance through their wedding night—yet he respects Ella's boundaries and refuses to force her. As threats close in from all sides—the demoness Chelsea's humiliation, the demon Asmodeus's deadly schemes—Lucifer shields her again and again. Slowly, something shifts between them.

He teaches her sacred combat. She uncovers the buried truth behind his fall from grace.
Ella lets go of her prejudice. Her heart begins to open. But just as love takes root, the arch-demon Beelzebub seizes the moment to launch a rebellion, taking Ella hostage to force Lucifer's hand.
In the critical moment, Ella fights back with the very combat skills Lucifer taught her. She channels her light into his dark relic, the Black Star, transforming it into the Star of Chaos. Together, they

title: Marked by the Alpha Queen I Swore to Kill
description: Lyra, the Omega princess carrying the weight of her slaughtered pack, is forced into marriage with Astrid, the Alpha Wolf Queen she believes massacred her family. What begins as a calculated assassination awakens a fated mate bond neither can escape. Trapped in the ancient castle, they circle each other like predator and prey. Cold hatred bleeds into forbidden desire. Lyra falls for the enemy she swore to kill, and the self-loathing tears her apart. In a moment of anguished resolve, she drives a poisoned blade into Astrid's heart. Fleeing home, Lyra is betrayed by her uncle, the true architect of the genocide. The shattering truth emerges: five years ago, Astrid took the blame for a massacre she tried to stop, sacrificing everything to save Lyra's life. The blade Lyra used was meant for her savior, not her enemy. Dying, Astrid transforms into a golden-flamed wolf and storms the frozen palace one last time. Through blood and fire, she tears down the lies. Lyra awakens as queen. Together, they execute the real murderer, claim twin thrones, and kiss before the realm as equals.

title: I Accidentally Seduced Hades
description:
Cupid Irene accidentally shoots her love arrow at Hades, the untouchable Lord of the Underworld. Cast into his realm, she must find his destined love to return to heaven—only to discover that the man she fears may be the one who fears losing her most.
Hades has ruled over death for millennia, but he cannot command his heart. As Irene fights against his possessive control, the cold god slowly learns to love, becoming her tender protector—and will decalare war on all of Olympus....

title: The Vampire's 100-Night Contract
description:
Betrayed by her werewolf lover and left on the brink of death after falling from a height, human girl Marian is unexpectedly saved by the mysterious vampire noble Cillian. But his rescue comes with a price — in exchange for the power to seek revenge, Marian must sign a “100-Night Blood Contract” and become his exclusive blood slave.
 Though Cillian appears cold and ruthless, treating Marian as nothing more than a contract possession, he repeatedly protects her from danger and destroys anyone who dares hurt her.

title: I Swapped My Vampire Husband
description: On her wedding day, Vera catches her husband Damien in bed with her best friend Selina—and overhears their plan to poison her with a vampire memory-erasing toxin before abandoning her. Vera secretly takes the antidote and fakes amnesia, but Damien immediately forces his brother Nikolai to pose as her husband in his place. To unveil the truth, Vera plays along with the charade, only to discover that Nikolai may have been in love with her all along—while her real husband suddenly wants her back. Torn between her repentant real husband and her devoted fake husband, which man will Vera choose?

title: Every Second Counts: 6 Hours to Save Dolly
description:
In a storm-battered border town, thunder booms. Single mom Lynn has nowhere to leave her feverish six-year-old, Dolly, so she's forced to bring the little girl to a business meeting.

When Dolly accidentally spills milk, the cold, arrogant Villa flies into a rage. She loathes children and hurls cruel insults, even taunting Dolly over her dead father.

As thunder rattles the windows, Villa corners and shoves the terrified child. Dolly loses her balance, crashes through the third-floor railing, and plummets straight onto Villa's luxury black car. The sharp hood ornament impales her; blood and rain streak down the vehicle as Dolly clings to life by a thread.

But Villa's first reaction when she rushes to the window? She screams over her wrecked car, completely ignoring the dying child below. Shattered by grief, Lynn sinks into utter despair.

A petty spat, fueled by pure malice, spirals into an unthinkable tragedy. In this world of cold-hearted indifference, who will pay the ultimate price?

title: The King's Forbidden Flame
description: Evangeline, the last holy maiden of the Yaxia witch clan, bears the destiny of breaking the curse upon the Kingdom of Light. Under secret orders from the elders, she travels to King's Landing, vowing to conceive a child with Valen Dracul, the first heir to the Seven Kingdoms. However, inside a storm-battered border tent, a formidable, untamed silver-haired man—suffering from a potent aphrodisiac poison—forces his way in. Recognizing his signature silver hair, Evangeline mistakes him for her fiancé, Valen, and submissively surrenders her virginity in order to fulfill her mission. The next morning, a raven delivers a message, leaving Evangeline in shock as she discovers that her real fiancé, Valen, had been in King's Landing the entire time. The man who forcefully claimed her last night was none other than her fiancé's biological father—Alistair Dracul, the supreme Black Dragon King and tyrant of the Seven Kingdoms! After entering the palace, Evangeline finds herself trapped between her cruel, incompetent fiancé Valen and the profoundly domineering Black Dragon King, Alistair. The unhealing true dragon brand on her collarbone, the confiscated core artifact of the witches, the clandestine trysts in the hidden chambers of the Red Keep, and the covert surveillance by the snake-woman Sasha, allow this forbidden flame—sparked by misunderstanding and exploitation—to burn fiercely throughout the entire Red Keep...

title: The Eyes That Cried For Her
description:
Falsely accused and framed, the former Luna, Grace, is exiled to the frozen wasteland by Alpha William, where she gives birth to his biological daughter, Lia, in the bitter ice and snow. Four years later, Grace reportedly "perishes," and William comes searching for his heir, only to be deceived by the antagonist, Caroline, who replaces the true heiress with her own biological daughter, Claire. Once brought back to the castle, the rightful daughter, Lia, is reduced to a lowly servant forced to wear a silver collar, suffering brutal abuse amidst howling blizzards and merciless whippings.
Meanwhile, having miraculously survived, Grace makes a powerful and dominant return under the alias Helena—now as the fiancée of William's younger brother, Raphael. At the grand engagement banquet, she is set to expose Caroline's shocking lie about stealing her "Eyes of Healing," and during the Holy Moon Spring trial, she will trigger the breathtaking awakening of Lia's true Alpha bloodline. Faced with the late-coming truth, the guilt-ridden Alpha can only resort to a life-for-life trade and self-blinding, initiating the ultimate groveling journey to win back his wife.

title: REBORN：The Dragon Princess Rejects The Marriage
description: Betrayed and murdered in her past life, Ella is reborn with all her memories right at the moment of her engagement banquet. Refusing to repeat her tragic fate, she decisively dumps her fiancé, Leon—a seemingly perfect heir hiding a vicious heart. Instead, she boldly chooses to marry Valerius, the terrifying Prince of the North. As Ella navigates the trials of exacting revenge on her toxic ex, exposing her two-faced illegitimate sister, and thwarting the deadly conspiracy of the Panther Clan, Valerius's unwavering devotion slowly melts her frozen heart. Ultimately, this ultimate power couple joins forces to crush their enemies and ascend the throne together.

title: Shattered Crown, Abyssal Throne
description: At the sacrifice ceremony, her newborn son was thrown into the deep-sea grinder. Iron teeth crushed flesh and bone. Blood mist stained the abyss red. They ripped off her last golden scale. Helena died cursing their names. Then she opened her eyes. Reborn. Back to the day of the royal engagement. Zael exposed her white-scale curse. Stripped her of everything. Exiled her to the mud. Forced to marry a crippled outcast. This time, she didn't cry. She crawled into the black market. With a kiss and a drop of blood, she woke a translucent monster — forgotten, abandoned, rotting in a cage. No one knew he carried the last drop of the Kraken's bloodline. No one knew her womb would birth a true god. Let her sister fake a royal heir. Let the prince kneel and beg. When the iron throne shatters and the abyss rises — Helena crushes the crown under her tail. Lifts her newborn high. "Bow. He is your new god."

title: Blood & Scales
description: A drop of his blood wakes a sea goddess. Now she owns him. Zero, a rogue super-soldier, infiltrates a black-market auction. Eve, a captured siren drained to bone, is the prize. One drop of his genetically altered blood hits her skin—and she awakens, golden-scaled and lethal. She slaughters the room and claims him as hers. But skin-to-skin contact between them ignites literal fire. His blood is her poison and her only cure.

title: Bound to the Vampire Emperor
description:
On her 18th birthday banquet, Selina, the heiress of a legendary vampire hunter clan, is offered as a peace offering by her own father to Lucien, the cold, bloodthirsty Vampire Emperor.
She would rather die than submit. She bites his lip to draw blood and draw a line between them at their wedding, climbs out the castle window at midnight in a desperate escape, and even drives a dagger toward his heart when he is consumed by desire. But Lucien is determined to tame this thorny rose. He imprisons her in his ancient castle, tears apart the deadly siren for her, stands his entire vampire clan, and refuses to let go even when she wounds him.
The blood bond ties the fates of these two mortal enemies inextricably together. The more she tries to run, the more her body betrays her, pulling her irresistibly toward him. Dark currents swirl beneath the castle's stone walls, and deadly dangers lurk in the shadows. Will this forbidden love born of possession end in bitter betrayal or all-consuming surrender?

title: The True Heiress Returns:Wrath of the Underworld Queen
description: After being cast into Tartarus by her own parents for five hundred years, Persephone—the true heir of Olympus—has finally returned. Betrayed, abandoned, and left crippled in the abyss, she endured unimaginable horrors while the adopted daughter who stole her crown, her family, and her fiancé was celebrated as the beloved princess of the gods. But when everyone expects Persephone to beg for forgiveness, she returns armed with the oldest bloodline in existence and the devotion of the King of the Underworld. This time, she will tear apart every lie—and make all of Olympus kneel before her.

title: Catching Merfolk
description: To rescue her captured mother, the mermaid Ella disguises herself as a human and infiltrates a research institute for ten years, eventually becoming Director Adam’s assistant. After enduring brutal tests and stealing access credentials, she discovers on her coming-of-age night that Adam has killed her mother. In despair, Ella awakens her sea-god bloodline, destroys the institute with sonic waves and ocean tides, exposes its crimes, avenges her mother, and returns to the deep sea with her ashes.

title: The Dragon King’s Beloved Slave
description: To rescue her sister from the gladiator pits, bastard-born noblewoman Livia agrees to marry Cato, the dragon clan's disgrace. She doesn't know he's actually the cursed Dragon King. As their contract marriage turns to passionate love, his secret is exposed. Livia leaves heartbroken—until his curse nearly kills him. Awakening her priestess magic, she commands a dragon and flies to save him.

title: No Escape from the Vampire
description:
On her 18th birthday banquet, Selina, the heiress of a legendary vampire hunter clan, is offered as a peace offering by her own father to Lucien, the cold, bloodthirsty Vampire Emperor.
She would rather die than submit. She bites his lip to draw blood and draw a line between them at their wedding, climbs out the castle window at midnight in a desperate escape, and even drives a dagger toward his heart when he is consumed by desire. But Lucien is determined to tame this thorny rose. He imprisons her in his ancient castle, tears apart the deadly siren for her, stands his entire vampire clan, and refuses to let go even when she wounds him.
The blood bond ties the fates of these two mortal enemies inextricably together. The more she tries to run, the more her body betrays her, pulling her irresistibly toward him. Dark currents swirl beneath the castle's stone walls, and deadly dangers lurk in the shadows. Will this forbidden love born of possession end in bitter betrayal or all-consuming surrender?

title: The Hidden Goddess Who Made Him Beg
description:
For three years, Persephone hid her identity as Zeus's daughter, staying by Pandaris's side without any complaint. When she realized he only saw her as a placeholder for his 'one true love'—and endured endless humiliation—she publicly severed ties with him and reclaimed her divine throne.
Returning to the mortal realm as their Guardian, she faced the same mockery. But when she revealed her true power, Pandaros fell to his knees, drowning in regret that came far too late.

title: The Alpha’s Virgin Mate
description:
Natasha, an 18-year-old half-human, half-wolf girl, disguises herself as a boy to go out with her best friend, but is unexpectedly kidnapped and taken to a werewolf island. There, she fatefully encounters Roderick, the brutal king of the wolf clan. While struggling to survive in fear and gradually awakening her wolf bloodline, she becomes entangled in Alexander’s coup plot against Roderick and Cecilia’s jealous persecution.
Afterimprisonment,betrayal,and life-and-death trials,Natasha uncovers the secret of her bloodline, becomes Roderick’s destined mate, and ultimately joins forces with him to crush theconspiracy, break the curse, and rule the wolf clan together.

title: Rejected by the Alpha, Claimed by the Northern King
description: Ella, a wolfless girl abandoned by her fated mate and cruelly exploited by her family, falls into despair and personally severs her mate bond. Forced to marry in her sister’s place, she becomes the wife of Luke — the legendary “useless” Alpha of the North who is also believed to be wolfless. Unexpectedly, Ella helps Luke awaken his wolf spirit, earning the overwhelming devotion of the entire North. Meanwhile, her ex-mate Alpha Noah, after uncovering the truth, is consumed by madness and regret, willing to do anything to win her back

title: Chained to the Dragon: The King's Forbidden Pet
description: Offered as a virgin sacrifice to the fearsome Dragon King Ignar, innocent Donna expects nothing but a brutal death. Instead, she is taken to his secluded castle — not as food, but as his personal pet. Stripped of her freedom, Donna is drawn into a terrifying yet intoxicating game of domination and submission. Ignar, a beast of immense power and dark desires, demands her absolute obedience. In his training chamber, using leather, silk, and ancient magic, he slowly breaks down her defenses. A dangerous soul bond begins to form. Donna soon realizes that her greatest danger is no longer the Dragon King's wrath — but her own awakening desires.

title: The Alpha King's Human mate
description:
For ten years, she was mocked by the werewolf pack as a human "mongrel." But overnight, she is chosen as queen by the most ruthless Alpha King of all. Before the entire kingdom, he kills his own father, imprisons her, and seals her fate with a possessive kiss — binding her ankle with a silver chain just to keep her by his side forever.
She tells him, "I'd rather die than be your plaything."
But he tears open the scars covering his body, revealing a twisted, obsessive devotion:
"I've waited for you for fifteen years.”
From a humiliated runaway slave to an awakened Wolf Queen, she finally realizes — what he offered was never a cage, but a love written by destiny itself.

title: Bedding My Three Werewolf Stepsons
description: In one day, Lyra loses her father, her lover, and her pack. Her only survival? Marrying an old Alpha who dies instantly, leaving her as the Luna of the powerful Reven Pack. Now, to keep her crown and her life, she must choose a new husband from his three predatory, dominant sons. They don't want to share the throne, and they certainly don't want to share her. As the brothers hunt for her heart and her bed, Lyra must decide which monster to surrender to.

title: She Swapped My Daughter！
description: On the night of the werewolf prophecy, two sisters give birth to daughters on the same day. The younger sister swaps the babies to steal the queen's throne for her own daughter. The older sister secretly swaps them back and spends 18 years patiently biding her time, plotting her revenge.

title: The Lycan Prince's Secret Heir
description: Five years after a star-crossed night she can't forget, Violet returns with a son who has a shocking secret: he’s a hybrid wolf-cub. When little Leo grabs the ruthless Lycan Prince Kylan in public and calls him "Daddy," Kylan is forced to "imprison" them in his manor to keep the boy from the King's executioner. As Kylan’s hatred for the weak turns into a dark, protective obsession, can Violet protect her heart—and her son—from the man who was never supposed to know they existed?

title: The Scent of My Fated Luna
description: A half-witch, half-werewolf teen forced to hide her true identity struggles to survive a high school divided by magic and fangs—while resisting her fated mate, the future Alpha who doesn’t remember their childhood bond, and battling the jealous rival willing to destroy her to claim him.

title: I Slept with My Three  Stepsons
description: A young girl hits rock bottom in a single day: her father dies, her boyfriend runs off with her best friend, and she’s condemned as a curse by her own pack. Just as they’re ready to burn her, the powerful Reven Pack declares her the destined Luna. To survive, she marries an old Alpha—who dies instantly. Now the elders say she must choose a new husband from his three sons, and whoever she picks becomes the next Alpha… or both packs will fall. Three heirs. One Luna. A deadly race for power—and her heart.

title: I Slept with My Three Werewolf Stepsons
description: A young she-wolf hits rock bottom in a single day: her Alpha father dies, her boyfriend runs off with her best friend, and she’s condemned as a curse by her own pack. Just as they’re ready to burn her, the powerful Reven Pack declares her the destined Luna. To survive, she marries an old Alpha—who dies instantly. Now the elders say she must choose a new husband from his three sons, and whoever she picks becomes the next Alpha… or both packs will fall. Three heirs. One Luna. A deadly race for power—and her heart.

title: My Alpha Sent me to Jail
description: Oh my god, it's him,my Alpha fiance.Framed for murder, imprisoned, and abandoned, I fight to clear my name and reclaim my lost love.

title: Sinful Triangle With Alpha's Twin Mates
description: Her kiss healed His  wounds, igniting a love destined for a tangled web of betrayal as her twin, Syvia, schemes and deceives.  Sylvia, consumed by jealousy, resorts to murdering her and takes her place right before the wedding night. Unbeknownst to Sylvia, She survives, vowing to reclaim her rightful place.

title: The Billionaire Makeup Queen
description:
Irene, the young billionaire CEO of the global makeup brand "Eir," decides to go undercover as a bare-faced student at a high school to find genuine friends. There, she encounters Regina, a vain girl who steals Irene's identity, claiming to be the famous "Goddess Eir". Enjoying the admiration of her peers , Regina and her followers constantly bully and mock the low-key Irene.  
Facing Regina's repeated provocations and malicious setups, Irene remains completely unfazed. She uses her undeniable aesthetic talent to turn the tables during school events like the "Star Night" and the talent show. Along the way, she earns the genuine love of Silas, the hockey team captain , and empowers a group of insecure girls who become her true friends. Ultimately, at a global beauty gala, Irene makes a stunning appearance , exposing Regina's lies and reclaiming her rightful throne as the Billionaire Makeup Queen in a triumphant counterattack.

title: Double Marriage with the Sexy Colonel
description:
To give her mother a proper burial, Becca marries a complete stranger. Three years later, she joins a military base as a doctor, where she meets Colonel Chris—a ruthless battlefield commander feared by enemies, and a man she cannot help but be drawn to.
Both trapped in hollow, loveless marriages, they restrain their feelings, test each other’s boundaries, and dance on the edge of temptation, growing ever more attached amid countless life-or-death rescue missions. When he finally resolves to put an end to his absurd arranged marriage, the name printed on the divorce papers strikes her like lightning: the unseen husband she has never met is none other than him. And she, in turn, is the very wife he has been desperate to walk away from…

title: 414 Utopia
description: Leo is nothing. Bullied. Locked in. Left to rot. Then the pink mist comes. A leopard-eared girl with a barbed tongue calls him king. She mends his bones with a kiss. Her vines devour the school. Her womb births a son of claws and ambition. Leo takes his throne. The bullies kneel. The world bends to pink. But the sky keeps flickering. Three cold suns burn behind the clouds. The sweet air tastes like bleach. His son's eyes go hollow. His queen's tail feels like rope. And somewhere — behind the vines, behind the crown, behind the endless purr of his perfect kingdom — a lock is still clicking.

title: Mommy, It's Smiling
description: Norla is seven. She says something grabbed her in the hallway. Adults say: you tripped. You're imagining things. Don't lie. She draws the face — that frozen, ear-to-ear smile. Twenty-three kids draw the same face. Adults say: bad influence. Clean the wall. The monster doesn't feed on blood. It feeds on disbelief. Every "it's not real" pulls it closer. Every crayon drawing tossed in the trash makes it stronger. The neighbor father scrubbed his son's art off the garage door. Now his face is locked in that smile. All across the neighborhood, adults press against windows — sightless eyes, jaws cracked wide. Only the children are left. Huddled on the school playground. Holding yarn bears and scribbled paper. Their only weapons: eyes that still see, and beliefs no one takes seriously. This is not an exorcism. This is a story about why grown-ups never see what's right in front of them. Claire finally believed her daughter. A cheap plastic bead necklace exploded with light. The monster didn't die. The adults just finally learned to shut up — and listen.

title: Captured by the pirate stepson
description:
Charlotte, the Saintess of the Holy See, is forced to marry an obese governor twenty years her senior. On their wedding night, she risks her life to flee the bridal ship—only to be captured at sea by Marcus, the governor’s notoriously ruthless pirate son.
Charlotte initially believes Marcus intends to drag her back and offer her to his father. But she gradually realizes that her dangerous, unhinged new stepson is far more terrifying than the repulsive governor himself.

title: My 78-Year-Old Grandma is a Super Soldier
description: They stole a dead soldier's pension. His 78-year-old widow came to collect—with a titanium bat. Dolores watches her bank balance hit zero. Thirty years of her husband's military pension, gone. The Wall Street scammers laugh. The police say wait three years. She grabs her husband's old bat and walks into their underground fight club. She didn't come for fame. She came for thirty thousand dollars and a dead man's honor. God help anyone in her way.

title: I Am Your Wall
description: In a world overrun by the dead, a mother's lullaby is the only weapon. Marin's baby, Win, is a beacon for the evolved horde—but her voice can freeze them in their tracks. Hunted by a false prophet who sacrifices children, and allied with Roxy, a mercenary turning into a monster, Marin must reach the last city. When the walls fall and the dead kneel, she becomes her son's wall. Mercy is not an option.

title: The Last Flight to Save My Son
description: When eight-year-old Noah’s arm is severed in a brutal factory accident, his mother Sarah enters a desperate race against time. With only 90 minutes to catch the last flight to Chicago for life-saving surgery, she faces more than just a ticking clock. The corrupt factory owners, Jack and Nora, will stop at nothing to silence her and cover up their negligence, even if it means letting Noah die. From blocked ambulances to airport standoffs, Sarah must fight a rigged system. In a heart-pounding climax, an airport manager risks her career to stop the world, giving Sarah one last chance to save her son’s life

title: Dark Angels' Devotion
description: I was one trigger pull away from ending it all when Asher Romano kicked down my bathroom door. He didn't come to save me; he came to claim me. Five powerful men, the "Dark Angels," owe me a debt of blood, and Asher is the first to collect. While my own father tries to destroy me with a scandalous video, Asher locks me in his estate, promising protection but delivering a gilded cage. He says he wants me to live, but I see the hunger in his eyes. In a world of betrayal and dark secrets, is Asher my savior, or just another monster waiting for his turn?

title: Ballad of the Phoenix Throne
description: The legendary life of Zoey Wolfe, the first and the greatest empress of all time.

title: My Fox Spirit Wife
description: Hank was born as the Fate's Favored, a man blessed with ordinary luck. Under his influence, his girlfriend Hannah saw her career flourish and rise higher and higher. Then, by chance, Hank crossed paths with a fox spirit—and from that moment on, his life was never the same.

title: Undercover as a Deliveryman
description:
"Ryan Grant, heir to a legendary martial master, became the live-in son-in-law of the Lewis family as a nobody, taking a job as a delivery driver to experience the full range of ordinary life. When his training was finally complete and his martial arts reached perfection, he stood against the Overlords to defend the nation's security, earning glory that would never be forgotten.
 But the Lewis family valued wealth over character and ultimately turned their backs on him. The Sheen family, meanwhile, threw their weight around and bullied Ryan without restraint. Ryan answered with an iron hand, punishing evil, helping the innocent, and upholding what was right."

title: Heaven Sent Blessings
description: On the eve of New Year, kind-hearted Yvonne was thrown out of her home by her ungrateful son and daughter-in-law. Unable to bear the decline of basic decency and morality, Heaven sent down two blessed children, Goldie and Jady, to help Yvonne, punish her heartless son and daughter-in-law, and reunite her with the biological son she had lost many years ago. Before returning to Heaven, Goldie and Jady offered New Year's blessings to all the kindhearted people in the world.

title: Raising a Reckless Disciple
description:
"Joe was Sage's chosen heir, though he knew nothing of his identity and continued living quietly at Serenity Academy.
 At the same time, the Moores came under attack. The Moore sisters fled for their lives and, by chance, crossed paths with Joe during recruitment before joining under his wing.
 Juliet Moore was reckless by nature, and her understanding of Holy Scriptures was often wildly off the mark. Yet somehow, through a string of absurd accidents, her cultivation surged right along with those misunderstandings.
 Later, when demonic cultivators caught up to them, Juliet suppressed them with ease."

title: My Stepson，My Mate
description: Forced into a marriage with the powerful old Alpha Mason, Alice becomes his "legal trophy wife," only to discover a devastating secret on her wedding night: Mason’s son, Noah, is her fated mate. Bound by a biological bond they can't fight, the arrogant young Alpha is torn between his hatred for Alice’s family and his primal urge to claim her. As Alice plays a dangerous game, using her status as Mason’s wife to drive Noah mad with jealousy, the tension between stepmother and stepson reaches a breaking point. In a house of secrets and betrayal, Alice must choose between the man who owns her and the one her soul demands.

title: The Mafia King’s Virgin Slave
description: Married for a year and still a virgin, Grace enters a brothel to learn how to please her husband—only to be abducted by the city's most ruthless crime boss, Sebastian. He claims she is a born submissive and vows to awaken her hidden desires through his brutal, relentless training. Determined to return to her husband, Grace resists—until his control turns into a temptation she can't fight. In Sebastian's world, surrender is the only way out.

title: Stolen Night with the Police Chief
description: A drunken one-night stand with the new police chief, Darren, was supposed to be Nora’s secret. But when her best friend Mary steals her identity and climbs into Darren’s bed, Nora is forced to watch as the imposter steals her life. While Mary schemes with a mole to frame her, Darren begins to suspect the woman in his arms is a fraud. Nora must expose the lie and reclaim her place in the Chief’s heart before she’s sent to prison for a crime she didn't commit.

title: My Poems Shake the Heavens
description:
Lan Grant was the reincarnation of the Master Sage. When he recited poetry, it could trigger cosmic disturbances—but he had no idea.
 One time while he was reciting a poem, the Lady Fox of Azure Vale and the Goddess of Divine Eyes happened to be dueling in the Overheaven battlefield. The phenomenon seriously wounded both women.
 The two fell to the mortal world and realized Ian was unfathomably powerful. They decided to stay by his side.
 Just then, villains from the Ascendancy came hunting them down, and everyone got caught up in another storm of trouble.

title: One Moon for Two Homes
description:
"On the night of her wedding, Autumn discovers that her husband, Dawson, and her mother-in-law, Lana, are planning to sell her. Determined to escape, she begins fighting for her freedom. Along the way, she forms a deep bond with her stepdaughter, Luna. Tragically, Luna is killed while trying to save Autumn.
 Despite repeated failed escape attempts and being imprisoned more than once, Autumn eventually proves her innocence and, with the help of the villagers, breaks free from Dawson's control. Throughout it all, she uses her wits to protect herself, including pretending to be pregnant and working with her senior schoolmate, Snow, who was also trafficked into the town. Facing relentless threats from Dawson and his family, Autumn shows extraordinary courage and intelligence. In the end, she not only ensures the villains receive the punishment they deserve, but also successfully divorces Dawson and begins a new life for herself."

title: Forbidden Salutes: One Night with My Stepbrother
description: Insecure and heartbroken after catching her boyfriend cheating, Chloe finds refuge in the arms of Liam, a battle-hardened retired Marine colonel. One wild, alcohol-fueled night later, she thinks she’s finally found her savior—until a shocking revelation turns her world upside down: Liam is her new stepbrother. Trapped under the same roof with the man who knows her every curve, Chloe is forced into a dangerous game of cat and mouse. He’s a man who follows orders, but when it comes to his new stepsister, Liam is ready to break every rule in the book to keep her in his bed.

title: Starlight with No Way Back
description:
"Shiloh Tanner was born into poverty. She fought her way into university through her own hard work, only to be manipulated and threatened by her mother and younger brother, who treated her like their personal ATM and drained everything they could from her.
By chance, she took a job at a boxing gym and met Asher Church there. When Asher realized Shiloh was his underclassman from university, he stepped in to help her. But then Shiloh’s mother threatened and pressured her to come up with $100,000. Asher had originally only meant to scare Shiloh a little, to teach her that men in the outside world were never as decent as they seemed. Instead, driven into a corner by her family, Shiloh unexpectedly took the initiative and came to him.
After they spent the night together, Asher mistakenly assumed she really was the kind of girl who cared only about money. Later, he accidentally overheard a phone call between Shiloh and her mother and finally realized he had misunderstood her.
One day, Asher's friend, James, invited Asher out for drinks. Asher knew the bar James mentioned was Phantom Lounge, where Shiloh worked, and for reasons he couldn’t quite explain, he went. There, he ran into his cousin Zeke bullying Shiloh. Asher stepped in, saved her, and took her home.
It was the first time Asher had ever met a girl who was so easy to pick on and so painfully naive, and before he knew it, he had developed a complicated fascination with her. After carefully probing into her family situation, Asher told her he could protect her and help her break free from them—if she stayed with him.
Shiloh refused and tried to leave in a hurry, but then her mother called and threatened her again, this time demanding $200,000. Asher said bluntly that they could do it again—something between two consenting adults. Shiloh hated herself for sinking to the point of trading her body like this, but she had no other choice. Asher comforted her, telling her she had done nothing wrong, that it was consensual, and urged her to relax.
The next morning, ...

title: Crown of Vengeance
description:
"Audrey Shayne, daughter of the Prime Minister, enters the palace under the name of Isabella Cole, the daughter of a lower-rank Censor, in order to avenge her family. Step by step, she rises from a Noble Lady to the highest rank of Palace, plotting each move carefully.
 She once believed the downfall of her family and the death of the former Queen were caused by the scheming women of the Palace. But as she investigates, she uncovers a shocking truth: it was King Michael himself who orchestrated it all."

title: His Contracted Virgin
description:
25-year-old housewife Sadie Miller, desperate to salvage her marriage with her cold, unfaithful husband Shawn, tries to learn about sex from a professional escort.
But there, she crosses paths with Guy Hawkins—the mafia boss of the Hawkins Syndicate, who numbs his pain from losing his family as a child through violence and BDSM. Drawn to Sadie's innocence and embarrassment, Guy proposes a one-month contract: she'll accompany him under the terms of an S&M agreement.
For Shawn's safety, Sadie accepts. Amidst training, humiliation, and temptation, she finds herself growing emotionally dependent on Guy.
After weathering emotional turmoil and life-threatening danger together, Sadie and Guy move beyond their master-servant roles. They become true partners, bound by love and a vow to each other.

title: Starry Fragments
description: After being abandoned in the wild by the Sharps to steal her luck, Marlene Sharp was taken in by Michael the Whole of the Magic Academy. Years later, having mastered the mystical arts, she left the academy to fulfill her destiny: to find her fated one, Shane James, and marry him as part of her Trial. At that time, Shane was gravely ill and on the verge of being overthrown by his younger brother, Chase. In a critical moment, Marlene appeared and married Shane in a flash wedding, using her powers to dispel the evil spirit threatening his life. Only then was the crisis temporarily resolved.

title: Wildfire Between Us
description: Against the backdrop of raging wildfires in Los Angeles, the contractual marriage between firefighter Liam and novelist Natalie is thrown into crisis due to misunderstandings, betrayal, and life-and-death trials. As the wildfires spread, Liam gradually realizes his true feelings for Natalie, while she reexamines their relationship through the pain. The two grow closer amid disaster and conspiracy, ultimately rekindling their love from the ashes.

title: Campaigning For Love
description: After a one - night stand with a handsome stranger, Sarah, a young campaign intern, realized that he was her boss, Senatorial candidate Christopher. In a tough campaign, their affair would be a career - ending scandal for both of them, so she concealed her identity. But did Christopher fall in love with her or the role she was playing? Will their love story destroy them or can they survive the scandal and become a powerful couple in the political world?

title: The Setup: Prof's Gambit
description: Elite attorney Wanda accidentally uncovers her husband Shane's affair with his student Yvonne while reviewing home security footage in search of a document. As a seasoned lawyer, Wanda keeps her composure and doesn't confront them right away. Instead, she quietly gathers evidence of their affair and their abuse of power for personal gain. Turning the tables, Wanda invites Yvonne into their home under the pretense of helping her study for the bar exam, deliberately allowing the two to continue crossing the line right under her nose. Meanwhile, she teams up with her journalist friend Willa, setting a carefully orchestrated trap and tightening the net step by step. Determined to make the betrayers pay, Wanda launches a high-stakes game of revenge, where intelligence is her sharpest weapon.

title: （Dubbed）The Quiet War
description:
"A top-tier doctor returned home, only to be greeted by her husband and his mistress's ""love child""? Her in-laws declared without a shred of guilt: ""You will raise this child!""
Chloe smiled. She sold their house and car, playing the devoted wife—until the day of the birth. Then she slipped off her wedding ring, donated every last cent, and left the country.
Overnight, the wealthy family crumbled into debt and ruin. Six years later, she returned with a love worthy of her, only to find her ex-husband on his knees at the airport, begging for her back.
She merely smiled faintly: ""Belated affection is cheaper than weeds."

title: Diamond Darling:Sweet Pregnancy Love
description: After a chance encounter, Elara and Aiden had a son, Jackson. Six years later, Aiden discovered the child's existence and began searching for him. During this time, Elara grew closer to Aiden while working at his company, and feelings slowly developed between them. Eventually, Jackson was recognized as Aiden's heir, and Elara found security and happiness as his mother.

title: （Dubbed）Off-Screen Lovers
description: Anna Charles  and Leon Grantk enter a sham marriage after Jack Moss's car accident, concealing their true feelings. As they work together on set, honesty begins to blend with affection. Eventually, secrets are uncovered, misunderstandings are healed, and they reach a heartfelt ending sealed by true love.

title: The Unbridled Heiress
description: Riley Sterling, the only heiress to an old-money equestrian dynasty, walks away from her family name after her father forbids her from racing. Determined to win the championship for her late mother on her own merit, she enrolls at Western High as a nobody. But Chloe Jenkins, the stable maid's daughter, is mistaken for the secretive Sterling heiress and decides to steal the identity for herself. Reduced to a manure-shoveling stable hand and targeted by a corrupt coach, Riley lets her family knowledge, elite riding skills, and bond with Night tear Chloe's lie apart—while national champion Liam becomes the first person to see who Riley really is.

title: Secret on the Yoga Mat
description: "Sophia believed her first love's lies, watched her daughter in danger and did nothing, convinced her husband George was a greedy fraud. Then the truth exploded—the man she despised was the silent force behind her success, while the one she trusted was stealing George's research and her fortune. By the time she understood, it was too late: George had moved on with the woman who always loved him, and her daughter had happily found a new mom. Left with nothing but regret, she realized some wounds never heal. ""The one you pushed away was the only one who ever held you up."

title: Arresting My Mafia EX
description: Judy, an elite FBI agent, faced with a dangerous undercover mission, Judy chooses to break up with her fiancé Federico, concealing the truth to protect his safty. Two years later, fate deals an unexpected hand when Judy is tasked with infiltrating a poweful mafia family. Disguised as an unassuming waitress, her worlds turns upside down when she discovers her target is none other than Federico himself - now the charismatic heir to the criminal empire. Will Judy arrest or fall in love again with Federico?

title: The Astronaut's Forbidden Girl
description:
Betrayed by her boyfriend and best friend, Luna finds an unexpected ally in Ryder—a legendary astronaut and her father's closest friend—who steps in to protect her when she needs it most.
Determined to start over, Luna fights her way into the Space Agency as an intern, only to find that Ryder is now her commanding officer and personal instructor, tasked by her father to "keep her in line." Desperate to escape his watchful eye, Luna plays a dangerous game—pushing boundaries, testing limits, trying to make him break the rules so he'll finally let her go.
But the game went wild. The cramped capsules, isolation chambers, high-altitude parachute training—What was supposed to be fake becomes real. Ryder's iron discipline shatters and transforms into burning desire of possesion, while Luna's defenses crumble. In this forbidden relationship, the two start to tango.
When their secret is exposed by rivals, Ryder doesn't run. He risks it all—his career, his reputation, his bond with her father—to fight for Luna. He ventures into danger alone to save her, then lays everything he has on the line at a high-society gala, dropping to one knee to propose.
From stern instructor to the man who kneels before her, their reckless game becomes the love that saves them both.

title: Falling for the LAPD Chief
description:
LAPD intern Nora rescues a drunken man from danger and shares an unforgettable night with him. She leaves at dawn, only leaving a borrowed necklace behind.
To her shock, the stranger turns out to be Darren, her newly‑appointed police chief boss. Obsessed with finding his mystery woman, Darren follows the necklace and mistakenly believes Nora's best friend Mary is her.
Though they work side‑by‑side with lingering chemistry, Darren cannot recognise the real Nora. Trapped in a case of mistaken identity, will the two ever uncover the truth?

title: LAPD! Open Your Heart!
description: Nora, a police intern, has a drunken one-night stand with the new chief, Darren. However, her best friend, Mary, steals Nora's identity and becomes the recipient of Darren's gratitude. While Nora quietly holds onto the secret, Darren begins to suspect she might be the mysterious woman from that night. As Mary schemes to climb the ranks by seducing Darren, she partners with a mole in the police station to frame Nora. Can Nora expose the deceit before it's too late?

title: Surrender to the Enemy
description:
The once-renowned Sterling family, once a household name throughout the city, was forced into bankruptcy, and its assets were fully acquired by their arch-rival, the Vance Group. Chloe, the down-and-out former president of Sterling, was cornered on the street by loan sharks demanding repayment and about to be beaten when, with no way out, Aria—the aloof and proud female CEO of the Vance Group—sped to the scene in her car and rescued her.
To raise the money for her terminally ill grandmother’s surgery and to infiltrate the Vance Group to uncover the truth behind her family’s bankruptcy, Chloe swallows her pride and signs an “Exclusive Submissive Contract” with Aria, becoming Aria’s personal assistant and exclusive sub. However, Aria—who to outsiders appears cold and ruthless, suffers from a fear of physical contact, and never takes off her gloves—seems to be using their master-submissive dynamic to subject Chloe to all sorts of humiliating, heart-pounding “training” sessions in private rooms and offices. In reality, though, she is secretly searching for a heart donor overseas for Chloe and repeatedly steps forward to shield her from the undercurrents of corporate warfare.
As Bruce—an ambitious executive at Vance—Vice President Rebecca, and Daphne, the heiress of a multinational conglomerate, become involved, the business conspiracy and traps behind the short-selling of Sterling years ago gradually come to light. After surviving a kidnapping in a cruise ship’s private cabin, a daring shootout to save a life, and several moments of physical and emotional intimacy, these arch-rivals—who had been at odds for a decade—finally break down their defenses and resolve their misunderstandings, evolving from a battle of wills into a wholehearted, mutual commitment.

title: My Rookie Secret Agent Lover
description: Rookie agent Ryan is assigned to investigate powerful CEO Vincent. Then comes the accidental kiss—and boom, Vincent proposes, and Ryan becomes his fiancé.To stay on the case, he goes undercover as an intern at Vincent's company—only to find someone else is mistaken as the CEO's lover......

title: The Sex Therapist & His Cold Virgin Client
description:
Eleanor has been married to Jett for two years. Plagued by severe sexual fear, she remains a virgin. She turns to Enzo, a top‑tier gynecologist‑and‑sex therapist—a man with a frosty public demeanor yet profound carnal knowledge behind closed doors. Seeing her repressed state and self‑loathing, Enzo proposes a one‑month “private therapy”: she will move into his estate to undergo transformative sexual awakening.
Beneath Enzo’s cold, controlling demeanor lies childhood trauma: he witnessed his mother murdered because of her sexuality. He seeks to tame desire through medical means, yet gradually loses control around Eleanor. Meanwhile, jealous female patient Riley, Jett—Eleanor’s unfaithful husband who already has an illegitimate child—and buried family secrets come into play. As every lie unravels, this so‑called “therapy” evolves into mutual healing revolving around love, power and redemption.

title: Fell for My Godfather
description:
My name is Rose. Nine years ago, I was dying from congenital heart disease when Leonard saved my life. My parents' car accident took everything from me, and made this handsome, austere heart surgeon my godfather.
From age 12 to 21, I watched him grow from a young doctor into Boston's youngest department chief. I also grew from a little girl who needed protection into a woman who made his gaze dart away.

I fell hopelessly in love with the man I should never love.

On that night when I was 19, I gathered all my courage to confess: "Leonard, I want to be your woman, not your goddaughter anymore."

But he coldly rejected me: "Enough, Rose. You're just my friend's daughter. My feelings for you are purely responsibility. If you're truly grateful that I saved you, please forget these ridiculous fantasies."
